swordsman heroes reborn.name: Swordsman (Heroes Reborn)
swordsman heroes reborn.origin: When the Fantastic Four and the Avengers sacrificed their lives to destroy Onslaught, Franklin Richards, the son of the FF's Mr. Fantastic and Invisible Woman subconsciously created a pocket universe to save their lives. There they spent an entire year reliving new lives "reborn" into a reality where they recently gained their abilities that vaguely mirrored how they gained their powers originally. In this new universe, Franklin created populated universe, including recreations of many of these heroes allies and foes. Among these creations was one based on the various beings on Earth-616 that took up the mantle of the Swordsman. left|thumb The past of the Swordsman of Counter-Earth remain unknown, however he believes to have had some kind of past with the time traveling Mantis. In his first recorded appearance, he was recruited by the S.H.I.E.L.D. to join their Avengers team. Their first mission would bring them to Norway to investigate Donald Blake's discovery of Thor. Swordsman would join his comrades in battling Thor and his brother Loki until Thor realized his brothers deceptions and would turn against him, joining the Avengers. Swordsman would next help his fellow Avengers in battling Kang and his lover Mantis. First being captured and having his swords taken as a trophy, Swordsman would get free along with his fellow Avengers and force Kang into retreating. He would earn Captain America's disapproval for almost killing Kang, violating the moral code that Cap placed upon the Avengers. When the Hulk would attack Avengers Island, the Swordsman would join Captain America in trying to stop the brute. During the fight his hands would be crushed by the monster and S.H.I.E.L.D. would have to evacuate him from the battle scene. In a coma, the Swordsman would be visited by Captain America who witnessing the Swordsman's bravery in battle against the Hulk would now consider the Swordsman a hero. When Loki would begin absorbing beings unique to Counter-Earth in a bid to boost his powers, one of his victims would be the Swordsman, who was still recovering in hospital. Eventually, the Avengers would defeat Loki and all of those who he absorbed would be ejected from his body. The seemingly recovered Swordsman would be among the Avengers gathered while the Atomic Knights of the Round Table would be busy constructing an Ultimate Nullifier weapon to destroy Galactus. Following the departure of Earth-616's heroes, the Swordsman became known as the "Last Avenger". However he soon learned that he had contracted cancer and began undergoing treatment. Before going he would recruit a group of heroes to become a new team of champions called the Remnants. He would take on the identity of Deadpool and briefly lead the group before going for cancer treatments. While taking time to meditate he would supposedly slip on a banana peel and learn of Counter-Earth's origins and decide that they were all living a lie and their reality needed to be destroyed. He would also begin eating a lot of fatty food gaining a massive amount of weight and take on a sidekick, a little boy named Cap. Stealing a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier loaded with nuclear weapons, Deadpool would garner the attention of the Remnants who would be hired by S.H.I.E.L.D. to recapture the stolen vessel. Confronting their former leader, the Remnants would learn of Deadpool's insane plot, but fail to stop him from launching his nuclear arsenal at the Watcher's moon base. Deadpool was seemingly killed as he was riding one of the missiles to its intended destination. He would fail at destroying the Counter-Earth dimension, succeeding only in ripping a hole in the fabric of time and space. He apparently survived the Nuclear strike and was later seen recruited by Dreadpool to root out the remaining members of the Deadpool Corps. When the mainstream Deadpool and Pandapool arrived in the Deadpool Tower, the Swordsman Deadpool was one of many alternate Deadpools to confront them, though they were all slaughtered by the arrival of the new recruits of the Deadpool Corps.

swordsman space phantom.name: Swordsman (Space Phantom)
swordsman space phantom.origin: This Space Phantom who impersonated the Cotati Swordsman was employed by Immortus in a complex plan to keep the Avengers occupied before the coming of Onslaught. Brainwashed by Immortus into believing he was the real deal, the Swordsman believed to be Mantis' ex-husband, who had left her for unknown reasons some time before. He was captured by Mantis' sons Malachi and Tobias, sent by a vengeful Mantis, actually another Space Phantom; he was then bringed to Kang's citadel Chronopolis, actually Immortus' Limbo. He was freed by a redeemed Iron Man, who had been controlled by Immortus since the so-called Operation Galactic Storm, sacrificing himself to stop Mantis.

Brainwashed by Immortus into believing he was the real deal, the Swordsman believed to be Mantis' ex-husband, who had left her for unknown reasons some time before. He was captured by Mantis' sons Malachi and Tobias, sent by a vengeful Mantis, actually another Space Phantom; he was then bringed to Kang's citadel Chronopolis, actually Immortus' Limbo. He was freed by a redeemed Iron Man, who had been controlled by Immortus since the so-called Operation Galactic Storm, sacrificing himself to stop Mantis.
fields.notes: When Crossing was first published, all the characters who appeared were intended to be who they actually were. Since the whole storyline started to make almost no sense after some author changes and continuity errors between the various series, Kurt Busiek retconned the entire event in into being a plan devised by Immortus in order to have the Avengers occupied before the upcoming threat of Onslaught. Nearly all the antagonists, except for Kang who was retconned into being Immortus, were then retconned into being Space Phantoms.

sy lewis.name: Sy Lewis
sy lewis.origin: thumb|left|Lewis the lawyer Sy Lewis was a lawyer who represented a number of wealthy clients during the 1940's. In 1942, he developed a get rich quick scheme that was complicated in its execution. Purchasing the aging castle Greywin (which was supposedly haunted), he then convinced his clients to purchase expensive life insurance plans. Then, posing as a man named Murdock, he sent notes to his clients warning them about his intent to swindle them out of their insurance money and asking that they meet. Then he used a number of special effects to make ghosts appear, hoping to frighten his clients to death and collect their life insurance. His first attempt claimed the life of his first client Mr. Morton; however, the death attracted the attention of the hero known as the Challenger who then began investigating Murdock. Learning that as Lewis, he owned the property, the Challenger tailed Lewis as he convinced his next client, idle heiress Linda Smythe to take out a life insurance plan as well. Later that night, as Murdock, Lewis attempted to eliminate her as well, but the Challenger prevented Murdock from tossing the girl from a staircase. During his struggle with the Challenger, Lewis ironically met the same end that he had in store for Linda: falling down the stairs to his death.
weapons: As Murdock, Lewis wielded an axe and also had a trained attack dog.

sybyl dorn.name: Sybyl Dorn
sybyl dorn.origin: Sybyl Dorn is one of the Brethren, a race of alien creatures created by Celestials on the planet Omega Climion Six from low-level bacterial life forms. Unaware of their own origins, the Brethren believed to be a pure and highly-elevated species. This inspired their mission of colonizing other worlds to genetically cleanse them. As an efficient fighter and warrior, Sybyl Dorn was the right hand of Thane Ector, the leader of her group. Even though she helped the Brethren destroy thousands of worlds, she also demonstrated compassion Thane Ector did not have when it came to their interactions with other creatures. At some point, Thane Ector's squad, including Sybyl Dorn, were captured by the Collector. They managed to escape and arrive on Earth, where they immediately started a plan to conquer it. Earth's Mightiest Heroes, the Avengers, posited an opposition. The Brethren erected a citadel and raided the planet with their army. In this context, Sybyl Dorn found herself challenged by the Avenger Sersi, with whom Ector had become obsessed with. She was tormented by Ector's minion, Fool, about her desperation. Sybyl Dorn personally attacked Sersi and attempted to consume her. Thane Ector himself stopped her attempt, causing Sybyl Dorn to mobilize the Brethren to depose Thane Ector by accusing him of treason for his actions and alliance with Sersi. Realizing the Avengers worked alongside the Collector, the Brethren turned against them. In fact, the Collector had freed the Brethren on purpose, to weaken Earth for him to acquire it as a prize. Sybyl Dorn proved her loyalty to Thane Ector as he was attacked by the Collector, who exposed the truth about the Brethren being bacterial creatures. The revelation was not enough to break her devotion. However, she became a target of the Collector, who reduced her to her primal state as a mere mindless germ. The destabilized Brethren forced a Uni-Mind to stop the Collector, but that led to extermination of their species.

sydney burr.name: Sydney Burr
sydney burr.origin: Nothing has been revealed about the past of Sydney Burr. As an adult, Burr worked as a scientist and inventor in his personal laboratory, but had no success with his inventions. One afternoon, Burr was working on a time machine when it began shooting out electricity. After recovering from the malfunction, Burr noticed that his cat was frozen in place. He looked out a window and found that the city below him and the entire universe was frozen in time as well, thanks to his machine. Being broke, Burr took the opportunity to become wealthy. He took a briefcase and went through the city scooping up valuables. After cleaning out a jewelry store and a bank vault, as well as taking jewelry and and wallets from people frozen on the street, Burr returned to his lab and reset the machine to unfreeze time. While basking in the belief he had just committed the perfect crime, Burr was startled by a knock at his door. When he opened it, Burr was greeted by a police officer and an angry mob accusing him of taking their things. While being taken outside, Burr asked how they knew he had committed the robberies. The officer replied that, despite being frozen in place, everybody could still observe and had seen everything Burr had done. Presumably, Burr was arrested and remains in jail.

sygnet.name: Sygnet
sygnet.origin: When Hela had taken over Valhalla and turned it into a reflection of her own realm, Niffleheim, Odin sent Sygnet and the rest of the Valkyrior ahead of him to fight off Hela, but she and her sisters were slain by Hela's minions. When Odin got there, he plead with her to bring them back to life and stop her madness, but she explained that after a recent encounter with Thor and Lady Sif, she realized that she had wanted to express her own feelings of compassion and desire to be a woman, but could not since she was burdened with being the goddess of death. Odin then took pity on Hela and granted her the wisdom and knowledge she sought. She went back to Niffleheilm, allowing Valhalla to return to its original form, resurrecting Sygnet and the rest of the Valkyries in the process.
abilities: Sygnet has had extensive training in unarmed combat swordplay, and horseback riding.
weapons: Sygnet uses a enchanted sword.

sykes trent.origin: Sykes Trent was hired by Banker Wells to rob the ranchers and set their homes ablaze in order to claim their ranches through the mortgages. This plot was eventually discovered by the Texas Kid who happened to be at the location of the arsonists latest attack but was unable to save the life of rancher Benito Thompson. Learning that all the properties attacked where paid for by mortgages loaned out by Wells, the Texas Kid stole the loot taken by the raiders and attempted to trick Wells into implicating himself by asking C.E.Humboldt, one of the other mortgagor targeted by gang of Wells, to toss a false note into Placer City bank with half of the stolen loot. Sure enough, Wells went to check on his men to see what they were up to. The Texas Kid clashed with them, keeping them busy long enough for the sheriff to come and arrest them all.
powers: None, base-line human.

syllie spider.name: Syllie Spider
syllie spider.origin: On Earth-22105, a newspaper cartoon strip illustrated by P.T. Parker on Earth-16216, Syllie Spider was a funny cartoon spider. One day Kingfisher and his menagerie confronted Syllie Spider, demanding he give them all the flies that he had caught. Syllie Spider refused, attacking Kingfisher with a brick, and was put in jail for it. While in jail, he used another brick to literally break the fourth wall and escape into Earth-16216, the world of his creator. Seeing J. Jonah Jameson mistreat Parker, Syllie Spider threw a brick at him and befriended a fly he was going to eat to see the world. Soon after, Madame Web and Spider-UK found him to ask for help, recruiting him into the Spider-Army to oppose Shathra. Syllie Spider was captured by Shathra's minions and was locked away on Loomworld with other captive Spiders whom Shathra was unable to turn with wasp-stings, including Spider-Mobile, Spinneret and The Other. They were eventually rescued by Hunter-Spider and Night Spider. When Silk slashed Morlun with the Totem Dagger, Loomworld was blown apart, and along with all other Spiders Syllie Spider was thrown into Earth-616, where local Peter Parker dealt a final blow to Shathra.

sylvester marston.name: Sylvester Marston
sylvester marston.origin: ===Origins=== Sylvester "Snake" Marston was born in Ontario, Canada. He was a skilled contortionist, but turned his skills to crime. ===Satan Squad=== Baron Brimstone teamed up with Snake and Hammer Harrison to form the Satan Squad in a series of crimes that would enable him to mass-produce the Sol-Mac weapon. When Satan Squad member Duke Dawson tried to rat out Brimstone to Pamela Quinn of Delmar Insurance Company, Snake and Hammer confronted them, and Snake wrapped his body around Dawson, crushing him to death. They turned Pamela over to Baron Brimstone. Later, Hammer and Snake led the Satan Squad in an attempt to steal the golden bell of the cathedral St. Gabriela of the Highlands, only to be confronted by Machine Man. Snake tried to wrap himself around the robot, but Machine Man spun himself at a terrific speed, hurtling Snake into the Satan Squad. Machine Man went on to defeat Baron Brimstone. ===Enforcers=== Snake and Hammer were recruited into the Enforcers by the Arranger, the Kingpin's top man. The original Enforcers were initially hesitant to accept them, but they proved their abilities in a brief scuffle with the others, and then they were formally welcomed by Fancy Dan, Montana, and Ox . The Arranger charged the Enforcers with the task of maintaining the Kingpin's extortion rackets, and the team made good on that in the days that followed, threatening and beating store owners and burning down property. When one of their targets was candy store owner Roberto Cassada, they provoked the ire of the Sandman, who was renting a room from Cassada's family. The Enforcers happened to run into Spider-Man, and managed to defeat him with their superior numbers. They chained him up and brought him to their hideout so that he could be turned over to the Kingpin, but Sandman came to Spider-Man's rescue. Snake was knocked out by Spider-Man. ===Eel=== He was impersonated by the Eel as part of a plot involving Daredevil, Mister Hyde, and the Enforcers. ===Seagate Prison=== Snake was imprisoned in Seagate Prison's supervillain cell block. ===Civil War=== During the Civil War event, he was captured by Baron Zemo's Thunderbolts and forced to join them or face jail time. He attended a practice session held by the Andreas von Strucker. Marston joined Thunderbolts army recruits Aqueduct, Killer Shrike, Slyde and Ox in battling citizens of Sydney, Australia who had been overcome by the energies unleashed by the Universal Wellspring.

fields.history: ===Origins=== Sylvester "Snake" Marston was born in Ontario, Canada. He was a skilled contortionist, but turned his skills to crime. ===Satan Squad=== Baron Brimstone teamed up with Snake and Hammer Harrison to form the Satan Squad in a series of crimes that would enable him to mass-produce the Sol-Mac weapon. When Satan Squad member Duke Dawson tried to rat out Brimstone to Pamela Quinn of Delmar Insurance Company, Snake and Hammer confronted them, and Snake wrapped his body around Dawson, crushing him to death. They turned Pamela over to Baron Brimstone. Later, Hammer and Snake led the Satan Squad in an attempt to steal the golden bell of the cathedral St. Gabriela of the Highlands, only to be confronted by Machine Man. Snake tried to wrap himself around the robot, but Machine Man spun himself at a terrific speed, hurtling Snake into the Satan Squad. Machine Man went on to defeat Baron Brimstone. ===Enforcers=== Snake and Hammer were recruited into the Enforcers by the Arranger, the Kingpin's top man. The original Enforcers were initially hesitant to accept them, but they proved their abilities in a brief scuffle with the others, and then they were formally welcomed by Fancy Dan, Montana, and Ox . The Arranger charged the Enforcers with the task of maintaining the Kingpin's extortion rackets, and the team made good on that in the days that followed, threatening and beating store owners and burning down property. When one of their targets was candy store owner Roberto Cassada, they provoked the ire of the Sandman, who was renting a room from Cassada's family. The Enforcers happened to run into Spider-Man, and managed to defeat him with their superior numbers. They chained him up and brought him to their hideout so that he could be turned over to the Kingpin, but Sandman came to Spider-Man's rescue. Snake was knocked out by Spider-Man. ===Eel=== He was impersonated by the Eel as part of a plot involving Daredevil, Mister Hyde, and the Enforcers. ===Seagate Prison=== Snake was imprisoned in Seagate Prison's supervillain cell block. ===Civil War=== During the Civil War event, he was captured by Baron Zemo's Thunderbolts and forced to join them or face jail time. He attended a practice session held by the Andreas von Strucker. Marston joined Thunderbolts army recruits Aqueduct, Killer Shrike, Slyde and Ox in battling citizens of Sydney, Australia who had been overcome by the energies unleashed by the Universal Wellspring.
abilities: Marston is a contortionist who can entwine his body around objects and other people.

sylvia corpo.name: Sylvia Corpo
sylvia corpo.origin: Daughter of real estate magnate Henry Corpo, Sylvia Corpo found a number of living stone gargoyles which her father threw out of an old building before tearing it down to build the Graycar Building. Being a superstitous man, Corpo did not put a 13th floor in the building, going straight from the 12th to the 14th floors. Sylvia, however, somehow had the ability to create a 13th floor which she could hide from existence upon command, here she created a home for the gargoyles. Gara, the king of the gargoyles, however, did not want Sylvia to be their ruler, though Sylvia soon discovered that she had some control over the actions of the gargoyles. When Venus attempted to access the 13th floor of the building, she discovered that the offices had been completely destroyed and the workers were killed. Gara then attempted to slay Venus as well, put she was able to destroy several of the gargoyles with an emergency fire axe she found on the wall. When police arrived, they could find no sign of a 13th floor and thought that Venus must have imagined it. Determined to get to the bottom of the mystery, Venus returned to the building that night and again entered the 13th floor. It was then that she found Sylvia and learned of her connection to the gargoyles, Sylvia then attempted to kill her before she could reveal her secret. Once she turned her back on Gara and the other gargoyles, they proceeded to attack Sylvia from behind, not wishing her to be their queen any longer. Sylvia ran down the corridor and saw an open elevator door. Unfortunately as she raced through she realized that there was no elevator on the other side and she plummeted to her death along with the gargoyles, who were crushed by the dropping elevator car.
powers: Sylvia seemingly caused the 13th floor of the Graycar building to disappear from existence.

sylvie hirt.name: Sylvie Hirt
sylvie hirt.origin: At the end of the World War II, Max Eisenhardt, the future Magneto, took revenge on the Nazi scientist August Hirt for his role in the genocide perpetrated against the Jews in Auschwitz by having 115 Jews in the concentration camp killed for one of his scientific experiments. Max, after finding him when he was fleeing to France, put him in a position to choose whether to hang himself or if he preferred to live, in which case Max would have retaliated by killing his father Leopold, his sister Greta, and his children Theodor and Sylvie. Eventually Hirt hanged himself in his own cell with the rope given to him by Max.

sylvie yaqua.name: Sylvie Yaqua
sylvie yaqua.origin: Dr. Sylvie Yaqua born as part of the Pacqui people from Peru. She was part of a research team formed by Valerie Cooper for the Commission on Superhuman Activities to create a new breed of super humans. Dr. Yaqua suggested the team should make use of rare drugs found in the jungles of Peru. The team successfully tested their research on Julia Carpenter who became "Spider-Woman". The team's leader, Dr. Napier, under the guidance of the Manipulator instructed members of the team to experiment on themselves. Yaqua gained powers through a variation of the same spider-serum which she had previously used in Carpenter. She used the codename Arachne. Yaqua realized too late that the Manipulator had tampered with the spider-serum. She needed periodic treatments with an antidote, or else her mutation would kill her. Yaqua became the leader of Deathweb. Her team briefly teleported to a wooded area in the Avengers Compound in order to spy on Carpenter. They left without being noticed. Death-Web assassinated the lawyer and the reporter Walt Weston, allegedly on orders from the political candidate Wilson Lambert. The two victims were perceived as threats to the Liberty Party. When the West Coast Avengers and their associate Spider-Man investigated the party's activities, Death-Web appeared to confront them. While Death-Web held their own in combat against the Avengers, they chose to kidnap Rachel Carpenter and fled the scene with their victim. Arachne threatened to kill Rachel if Spider-Woman (Carpenter) refused to kill Spider-Man on her behalf. Spider-Man and Spider-Woman survived the destruction of Mike Clemson's base, but they realized that Death-Web had already left the base by the time of its destruction. The two heroes used a spider-tracer to track down and rescue Rachel. Death-Web assassinated the political candidate Michael Galvin, on apparent orders from his traitorous ally Wilson Lambert. When the West Coast Avengers arrested Arachne and her allies, Lambert was willing to leave his hired assassins to their fate. In retaliation, Arachne revealed that they were working for him. The scandal destroyed Lambert's political career. Death-Web resurfaced to stage an ambush attack on Spider-Woman, Rachel Carpenter, and Spider-Woman's parents. Death-Web and the Manipulator kidnapped Rachel and her grandparents. They used the hostages' assistance in obtaining plant samples required for the Manipulator's experiments. Arachne and her team had their powers enhanced by the Manipulator's new serum. But they exhausted themselves when forced to battle Spider-Woman before their bodies had time to adjust to the effects of the serum. Before losing consciousness, Therak incapacitated the Manipulator, as he was fed up with the man and his schemes.
powers: Arachne is capable of physically generating webbing and neurotoxins from glands in her wrists.

sylvius.name: Sylvius
sylvius.origin: Sylvius was a military soldier chosen to be a part of the S.C.A.R.s program developed by General Sam Ryan, Dr. Young Soo Pock, and J. Jonah Jameson. Unfortunately, the cybernetic upgrades seemed to cause mental instability. Sylvius' partner began taking mercenary jobs on the side to allow them to kill more. Finally, S.C.A.R.s was disbanded. Ballistique and Rococo were both mind-wiped and given civilian lives. Sylvius, as the only member of S.C.A.R.s who appeared mentally stable, was allowed to stay in military service. She was told Ballistique and Rocky had died. She continued her service and was eventually recruited by the MRD. She was part of the team that attacked X-Factor Investigations crew. After Ballistique and Rocky regained their true memories, Sylvius gladly rejoined the team, assisting in the attempted assassinations of Dr. Young Soo Pock and Mayor Jameson. S.C.A.R.s was foiled in both attempts by the interventions of X-Factor Investigations and Black Cat. Sylvius and Rocky were able to escape in a helicopter, but Ballistique was attacked psychically by Monet and left in a permanent coma. thumb|200px|right|Sylvius sending out her EMP blasts

symbionic man.name: Symbionic Man
symbionic man.origin: Dr. Simon Ryker was trying to successfully create a super-soldier robot, but it lacked life energy. After approaching Reed Richards and being refused access to his computer's energy to power his creation, Ryker later siphoned energy from Dr. Doom's armor, causing his creation to begin breathing. He was unable to siphon enough energy, however, and the creation simply slept within its protogenic gel. Coming upon the Sub-Mariner, Ryker released the Symbionic Man into the ocean, where it immediately began feeding on the ocean life all around him thanks to his symbiotic powers. All the while, however, he was still entirely under the control of Ryker's computers, and was sent after the Sub-Mariner as an ultimate source of power. The Symbionic Man ambushed a contemplative Sub-Mariner and began sapping his life energy to the point where he and Namor were so merged that Namor almost gave his life essence over to the Symbionic Man without a struggle. However, he broke free of the robot's control and threw him towards an old shipwreck. Here, the Symbionic man found a giant squid which he also used his powers to control and used the giant creature to again attack Namor. This time he attempted to sap the Atlantean's power through the tentacles of the giant squid. Again, Namor managed to escape the control of the Symbionic Man and threw the giant beast skyward, inadvertently knocking Ryker's ship out of the sky, severing its computers link with the Symbionic Man. Free from the control of the computer, the Symbionic Man told Namor that he had never wished to harm him as he understood the significance of life. He then returned Namor's stolen life essence, and apparently died, becoming inactive. .
abilities: The Symbionic Man is an excellent swimmer.
weaknesses: The Symbionic Man possessed no consciousness of his own, he had to absorb the consciousness of other sentient beings in order to have higher-level thinking.

syndicate luke and matthew.name: Syndicate (Luke and Matthew)
syndicate luke and matthew.origin: ===Beginnings=== Matthew and Luke first met Professor Charles Xavier when they attempted to rob a bank where Xavier has been banking for nearly twenty years. Xavier was there to inquire why all his assets were suddenly frozen. Apparently his account was under investigation ever since his recent falling out with the Hellfire Club and they were trying seize all his assets. Due to the Syndicate's mutant powers, he was able to fry the security systems and easily hold everyone in the bank hostage. Xavier attempted to telepathically force them to give themselves up but was unable to due to Syndicate's interlinked grey matter which made them immune to his telepathy. In order to escape alive, Xavier concocted a plan with his fellow hostages. Xavier tapped into the recesses of his fellow captives' minds and removed their mental blocks so that they could fight off their captors. After Xavier successfully got his fellow hostages out of the bank, he opted to stay behind. Xavier tried to reason with the boys but when that failed, he used his telepathy to read their minds and found out that Matthew and Luke were only robbing the bank so that they could get enough money to pay for their ailing sister's operation. Xavier threatened to telepathically order their sister Alice, who was at Central Bronx Hospital, to throw herself off the roof to her death. Syndicate finally agreed to give himself up to the authorities, but Xavier had something else in mind. Xavier telepathically broadcasted a scenario where Matthew and Luke were gunned down by the police into the minds of everyone gathered there to provide them closure. He offered them a chance at redemption, but not as one of his X-Men, but to become one of his many undercover agents. Syndicate's mission was to get back the assets and funds that the Hellfire Club took from him and Xavier offered to pay for their sister's operation if and only if they completed the mission without taking a single life. === Joining X-Men and Ultimatum=== After accomplishing his task with Hellfire Club, Syndicate is requested by Xavier to join another "Shadow X-Men", Psylocke, tasked with bringing down the Fenris Twins, looking for ways to expose their illegal dealings. However Xavier was reported killed soon after and the pair decides to move to Xavier's School and to reveal their existence to the official X-Men. Psylocke subsequently joins Bishop's new X-Men team, while Syndicate decides to settle at the school and only later join the X-Men team. During the events of Ultimatum, when William Stryker attacked the school in order to serve vengeance for the death of his family, despite the X-Men not being involved and the school being full of children, Syndicate was the first one to be shot to death with Matthew dying first before Luke was then killed.
powers: Heart pumps out an electromagnetic pulse with each beat. After Xavier's training, Syndicate can now suppress the EMP for over 2 hours at a time

Syndicate's mission was to get back the assets and funds that the Hellfire Club took from him and Xavier offered to pay for their sister's operation if and only if they completed the mission without taking a single life. === Joining X-Men and Ultimatum=== After accomplishing his task with Hellfire Club, Syndicate is requested by Xavier to join another "Shadow X-Men", Psylocke, tasked with bringing down the Fenris Twins, looking for ways to expose their illegal dealings. However Xavier was reported killed soon after and the pair decides to move to Xavier's School and to reveal their existence to the official X-Men. Psylocke subsequently joins Bishop's new X-Men team, while Syndicate decides to settle at the school and only later join the X-Men team. During the events of Ultimatum, when William Stryker attacked the school in order to serve vengeance for the death of his family, despite the X-Men not being involved and the school being full of children, Syndicate was the first one to be shot to death with Matthew dying first before Luke was then killed.
powers: Heart pumps out an electromagnetic pulse with each beat. After Xavier's training, Syndicate can now suppress the EMP for over 2 hours at a time

syne.name: Syne
syne.origin: Syne the Memotaur is one of the Hex, the six Eternal war machines. The nature of the Hex means that Syne has spent the vast majority of her life in stasis. The Machine referred to her as a "million-year-old teenager". When Druig became Prime Eternal, he declared the mutants of Krakoa to be enemies of the Eternals, and activated the Hex to attack them. Exodus, Jean Grey, and Namor were able to slay Syne, at the cost of Exodus' life. However, like any Eternal, Syne was quickly resurrected, in exchange for the life of a human known as Arjun. While loyal to the orders of the Prime Eternal, Syne's personal interests lie in creative writing. Whilst attacking Krakoa, Syne simultaneously began consuming large amounts of poetry. She encourage a human girl named Sally to start a poetry zine, saying she "always wanted to be published".
abilities: Multitasking: Syne is apparently very good at multitasking as she was capable of chatting on the internet and compose poetry while fighting on Krakoa against the X-Men.

synth.name: Synth
synth.origin: Synth was one of those who rebelled against Umar. She was also a member of the rebel council who advised their leader, Clea. Synth was part of the mission to secretly kidnap Umar's captain of the guard, Orini, during which she and a male rebel were captured and brought before Umar. After they both refused to talk and proved to have psyche-shields that prevented them from being mentally compelled to speak against the rebellion, Umar, as Clea had predicted, ordered them to be thrown to the Mindless Ones. Once Captain Orini had opened a warp in the barrier, a third rebel (a disguised Rahl) attacked the other two guards, giving Orini a chance to shove the two captives through the warp. Rahl then jumped at Orini with enough force to propel them both through the warp as well. As the barrier sealed itself, the other guards saw all four being overwhelmed by the Mindless Ones and left to report back to Umar, unaware of the fact that those Mindless Ones were merely an illusion cast by Clea. Synth later led a mission to ambush some royal guardsmen in a village marketplace. However, it turned out to be a double-trap as they were themselves ambushed by more guards. Unable to fight back effectively against the guards who were empowered by power wands, Synth was captured and recognized as one of the rebels who had been thrown to the Mindless Ones. When an Outcast intervened and freed her, the guards turned all their attention on him, enabling the rebels to recover and help the Outcast. Once the guards had been defeated, the rebels made them forget that they had ever seen Synth, then they fled from the village, unaware that the measures they were taking to avoid being followed were not effective against that Outcast. After using the warp in Saftur's cellar to get far away from the village, Synth mentioned that she feared that the ambush meant that someone may have informed on them. After returning to the rebel stronghold, Synth went to report to Clea and Rahl on how her mission had gone wrong and about the intervention by the Outcast. Seconds later, that Outcast made his presence known and revealed himself to be Doctor Stephen Strange and stated that he had come to aid the rebellion. Synth was part of a rebel council meeting at which it was agreed that the rebellion was at an impasse and needed more information on Umar's troop movements before they could plan effectively. When Clea stated that she would try again to probe the mind of their prisoner, Myrra pointed out that she hadn't had much luck in cracking Captain Orini's psychic shields and suggested that maybe she should let someone else try. Synth agreed that Myrra had a point and mentioned that, although none of them were quite her equal, they also weren't related to Orini. Clea was upset by the implication that she might have been going easy on their prisoner because he was her father but Strange suggested that she might have a subconscioous block that was preventing her from probing her father's mind as deeply as she would have liked. Later, after Strange had used the Eye of Agamotto to reveal all of the secrets that Orini had been hiding, Synth was present with Clea and the rest of the council when Strange revealed the shocking fact that Umar was Clea's mother.
powers: Synth possesses minor mystical abilities. Synth (like all the rebels) had a deep psychic shield conjured for her by Clea that prevented her from being mentally forced to speak against the rebellion.

synthia naip.name: Synthia Naip
synthia naip.origin: Synthia was a member of an unknown alien race of crystalline beings. According to her, her race was being hunted to extinction by the Dark Ones, who hate and fear the light and pleasure of the crystalline beings. Synthia fled to earth where she encountered Beast and began siphoning energy from him to survive. She also discovered that mutants were undetectable by her and assumed this was truth for the Dark Ones as well. She seduced him and convinced him to aid her if and when the Dark Ones attacked. One did, and Beast's surprise attack allowed it to be destroyed. As thanks, Synthia freed him from her spell and returned his energy. Later Synthia met Starfox who tried to win her affection, but she kept brushing off his advances. He was only convinced to leave her alone when she revealled her true form.

syphon warpies.name: Syphon (Warpies)
syphon warpies.origin: thumb|left|175px The young boy known as Syphon was "rescued" by agents of the R.C.X. when he was younger and brought to their facility to be raised. It is unknown if Syphon was in the group of Warpies that was brought to Braddock Manor in the middle of the night by Agent Michael, Agent Gabriel, and the others, but he is in the age range that most likely did live there for a short time. Syphon was assigned as an escort to Nightcrawler while Excalibur was being held at Cloud Nine by Peter. He prevent Nightcrawler from using his powers, Syphon grew to like and respect the older man even thought they had just met. Later when the battle broke out between Excalibur and the R.C.X., Syphon stood with Agent Luke and the other Warpie elite teams until they were frightened by Kylun's ability to replicate sounds. He was almost beaten by Luke for attempting to leave, until Nightcrawler rescued him and told him to run away with the other Warpie children. In the corridors the children ran into Wire and Prune and told them about the fight, who then gathered some other Warpies and came to help the super-heroes. It is unknown if Syphon lost his powers when the other Warpies lost theirs on Otherworld. thumb|right|280px
powers: Currently none, all of the Warpies were depowered by Captain Britain on Otherworld using the Sword of Might. {{Navigation
weaknesses: Syphon is a young boy who is easily frightened by loud sounds.

sysop.name: Sysop
sysop.origin: Sysop was a member of the Programmers, a peaceful cast of the Stark species, an extraterrestrial race who found the Iron Man armors after they were launched into space, who adopted and adapted the technology and worshipped Tony Stark as their god. Sysop attracted Tony Stark into the 28th Century and begged for Tony's help in bringing peace to his people, who were overcome by violence and famine. Tony stayed with them for some time, trying to solve their problems and wondering what caused the catastrophe that led him to fire his armor off to the Stark world, but when violent Stark barbarians found the Programmers' bunker, Sysop arranged to send him home, lest his presence lead to temporal disruptions. As Tony was being sent home, barbarians burst in and threatened to kill him; Sysop destroyed them all to ensure that Tony returned home safely.

syyr greyrun.name: Syyr Greyrun
syyr greyrun.species: White Room Kymellian seemingly powered through Antigenesis
syyr greyrun.origin: ===Origins=== A member of the White Room, an off-shot of the Kymellians created by the Kree, Syyr Greyrun was gifted with "the sight beyond sight." He became a sage, called the Moonlight Eye, and the wisest among his community. ===Novahala=== After Thanos attacked Earth and Black Bolt detonated Attilan, the Universal Inhumans departed the planet. Unwelcome in their homeworlds, they made of Akuunos, the land of the godless Centaurians (or Akuun) on Centauri-IV, their new home, and built Novahala. When a mysterious Obelisk crashed in the Great Desert outside Novahala, the Moonlight Eye ventured to examine it with his powers. Unfortunately for Greyrun, the structure took control of him. Light Brigade members Midnight Blade and Stonethrower were sent to retrieve Greyrun, but his powers amplified by the Obelisk forced them to retreat and leave him there to die. thumb|left|Greyrun's corpse Some time later, the crew of Inhumans led by Medusa visited the site of the Obelisk with the queens of the Universal Inhumans, and Greyrun's carcass laid next to the Obelisk.
powers: Syyr Greyrun was gifted with the sight beyond sight. He could make appear a psionic eye to read into objects. Possibly only when enhanced, this eye could fire destructive blasts.
abilities: Greyrun's power made him the wisest of the White Room.

szandor sozo.name: Szandor Sozo
szandor sozo.origin: Magister Szandor Sozo was the Sorcerer Supreme of the Thirteenth Dimension, somewhere far from Earth across the Dimensional Gulf. He was a friend to other magicians, such as the Ice Duchess, the Crimson Gypsy, and Dr. Warlock. Despite witnessing signs of an anomaly, Sozo was surprised by the magic-hunting Empirikul. The Empirikul overpowered the magicians, slaying all of Sozo's friends. Sozo managed to flee to the mother lodge as his magic withered. Once he was cornered, he used his Eye of Thelema to send an alert to every magic-user across the dimensions, as many others of his colleagues had been hunted down. The Empirikul's Witchfinder Wolves soon caught up to Sozo who invoked Thelema for help in vain, and heavily damaged him. The leader of the Empirikul, the Imperator, arrived and destroyed the magical butterflies of the Eye of Thelema that were carrying the warning. Sozo was ultimately "purified" by the Empirikul with holy acid.
powers: Sozo was a master of black magic and could cast spells, including the Indigo Chains of Odogo (mystic energy chains).
affiliations: Ally of the Ice Duchess the Crimson Gypsy and Dr. Warlock

t j vance.origin: T.J. Vance, or Teej as he likes to be called, is the owner of Naked Truth, a sleazy tabloid magazine that has its offices located in Times Square. Through an invasion of privacy, Vance was able to obtain topless photos of the super-heroine She-Hulk, who at the time had just recently joined the Fantastic Four. When She-Hulk -- in her civilian identity of lawyer Jennifer Walters -- learned that Vance had purchased the photos, she tracked him down to his office with her then boyfriend Wyatt Wingfoot to try and get Vance to cease and desist. The lecherous Vance tried to smooth talk Walters into abstaining, but his advances only caused her to make more legal demands. Having had enough, Vance then told Jen that it was too late and the photos were already sent to be published. He then gloated about the money he made on pre-sales of the magazine, showing off his safe which was filled with money. Reverting to type, "Teej" then tried to make untoward advances on Jen. Having had enough of dealing with such a lecherous man, Jennifer turned into the She-Hulk. Vance became instantly frightened, but instead of hurting him, She-Hulk instead crumpled up the bank safe into a ball for extra "security". She then tossed it into Vance's hands, the sudden weight made it tumble to the floor, taking Vance with him. Ultimately Vance's photos did little if anything thanks to an overzealous photo developer who, upon seeing the She-Hulk's green skin, thought this was a flaw in the photography and "color corrected" the photo so that She-Hulk appeared to be a Caucasian woman. Without any point of reference to verify if this was indeed the She-Hulk, the photo was generally regarded as some generic woman, allowing She-Hulk to dodge any controversy that might have been caused by the nude photos.

t w erwin.origin: Dr. Erwin was an eminent mathematician, who brought fame to the Miskatonic University, Vermont, with his theories and research on parallel time. tabicantra.name: Tabicantra
tabicantra.origin: Tabicantra was sent by Azmodeus, who wanted to control the Ghost Rider but knew that he was dependent upon Johnny Blaze, to destroy the control that the motorcyclist held over him before infernal souls had finished sifting through the Netherglass. She first encountered Johnny when he was riding his motorcycle to the side of her car. Although she thought that he was handsome, she remembered her mission and shot beams out of her eyes, causing a bridge to fall apart while he was crossing it. He survived, but Asmodeus knew that every time Johnny let out the Ghost Rider, his control would keep declining and Tabicantra briefly passed by him again at Becky's Diner before she materialized trucks in the middle of a highway and caused them to burst into flames, leading Johnny to transform into the Ghost Rider again. Then, she caused her car to catch on fire, luring Johnny to her and after he carried her out, he agreed to let her ride on his motorcycle and invited her to eat steak at the Ridge Inn in a nearby town. While Johnny was parking his motorcycle, she shot beams out of her eyes and caused a demon to appear and attack him, who transformed into Ghost Rider again. After the demon was defeated, Tabicantra had steak with Johnny before her attraction to him made her decide to betray Azmodeus but before she could warn the motorcyclist, he had to pay their check. After going outside, Johnny allowed her to speak, but before she could warn him, Azmodeus' demons, led by V'Zarr-Than, attacked them. Johnny attempted to transform into the Ghost Rider but she caused him to feel pain in his head, knocked him unconscious with a blast from her eye, and conjured a globe of force around him to protect him from the demons, but it drained her strength. She knew that she couldn't survive until the souls ran out of Azmodeus' Netherglass and that the globe protecting Johnny would die with her, so she drained away her own life-force and used its power to strengthen her waning magic before destroying V'Zarr-Than and the other demons, but also dying in the process and being sent hurtling for all eternity into the netherworldly void.

tabith.name: Tabith
tabith.origin: Like every creature found on the Beyonder's Battleworld following the events of the first Secret Wars, Tabith was the product of the subconscious mind of the Fantastic Four's Thing. The Thing had decided to remain on Battleworld after discovering he could change back and forth between human and Thing forms. Each of these creations were based off some aspect of Ben's memories or personality, with entirely fabricated backgrounds and origins. She was the future caretaker for Juneyar the future ruler of the kingdom of Muab, who for reasons unknown, was taken out of the city in a caravan. However if he was away from the kingdom for more than a month it would succumb to the power of black magic. The boy was sought after by Grimm the Sorcerer who sent his minions to attack the caravan. The attackers were prevented from stealing the boy by the Thing and his companion Tarianna. Tabith, dying, had the Thing swear to get the boy to Muab. Nicknaming the child "Junior" (which Tarianna pronounced "Juneyar") the couple made the dangerous trek to Muab. Along the way Ben became attached to the child and briefly considered keeping him but decided against it. They were impeded by minions of the Sorcerer but made it to the city of Muab. When the Sorcerer made a last ditch effort to capture the child, Ben was forced to choose rescuing the child over Tarianna who was spirited away. After getting the child to Muab, Ben learned how important Juneyar was to these people. However, even though he was hailed as a hero, the Thing did not linger and departed shortly thereafter to rescue Tarianna.
powers: Tabith was a magic user that could at least fire bolts of mystical energy.

tabitha briggs.name: Tabitha Briggs
tabitha briggs.origin: Tabitha Briggs was the mother of Bailey Briggs. When Bailey was approximately seven years old, they were kidnapped by Mister Negative and his Inner Demons, who sold them to Madame Monstrosity for experimentation. Bailey was spliced with a spider, becoming a "Spider-Boy" Humanimal but soon escaped from the Stillwell Farm and became a costumed sidekick for Spider-Man. Meanwhile, Tabitha herself was spliced with a house cat, becoming a cat-like Humanimal. Like other Humanimals, she was pressed into slave labor around the Estate, becoming Madame's housemaid. Because her appearance was radically changed, Spider-Boy did not know what had happened to her and continued operating as a costumed superhero for the next three years. thumb|left|Tabby as a cat Humanimal At some point Bailey was stabbed with a mystical Totem Dagger which erased his entire existence: both the physical traces of his life as well as the memories everyone had of him, including his mother. Bailey was eventually restored to life, but the memories others had of him were not. His activities as Spider-Boy quickly caught the eye of Madame Monstrosity, who quickly recognized her handiwork yet did not remember creating him. Learning his batch number from a barcode tattoo, she was able to recover the biological remains of both the boy and the spider and fused them to make a new creation: Boy-Spider. Taking Tabby with her, Madame Monstrosity took Boy-Spider to New York City and let him loose to lure Spider-Boy out. A few hours later he came back, shaken and spooked by what he experienced. As Madame Monstrosity drove off, Boy-Spider was calmed down by Tabby's cat purring, which was part of her plan, as she had deduced her to be Spider-Boy mother from their shared DNA. Tabby quickly came to have motherly feeling for the Boy-Spider, despite being unable to explain them. Meanwhile, Madame Monstrosity was able to read Boy-Spider's memories and recover information about the Spider-Boy from them. Soon, Hellifino delivered both Spider-Boy and his friend Christina Xu to the Farm, where Christina was spliced with a pigeon and turned into a bird Humanimal. Spider-Boy broke out and could not be restrained even by all of the strongest Humanimals at Madame Monstrosity's disposal, so she she set Boy-Spider after him. Spider-Boy punched him, and Tabby scratched him to get him away from her "son", at which point Madame Monstrosity reveled in revealing that Tabby was Spider-Boy's mother, even though she had no memory or feelings for him. Defeated by the leverage, Spider-Boy as forced to yield. Madame Monstrosity caged Bailey Briggs and began torturing him for the secrets of making the others forget him, assuming it to be part of his powers. Tabby overheard this and asked Madame about the situation, as she had no memory at all for Spider-Boy yet had feelings for Boy-Spider who was his genetic "brother". Madame Monstrosity brushed Tabby off, slipping that she planned to dissect Spider-Boy for his secret. Tabby went to Christina to ask her to rescue her friend, but Christina already used her new power to speak pigeon to alert the Avengers to their location. As Madame ordered her other Humanimals to attack the intruders, Tabby and Christina released Spider-Boy from his cage, but instead of escaping he went for the highest floor of the Estate, which even Tabby had never been too. It was guarded by Hellifino, but Tabby and Boy-Spider distracted him just long enough for Spider-Boy to get to his target: Madame's husband Jeremy Stillwell who had been body-swapped with an owl when the procedure of unsplicing them did not work. Spider-Boy forced Owl Jeremy to confess to other Humanimals that his wife never had a way of returning them to normal, thus breaking the hold she held over them. thumb|Restored to human form Meanwhile, Madame Monstrosity had spliced herself with multiple different animals, becoming a horned, dragon-like creature several stories tall that was soon teleported away by a party unknown to the others. The Avengers and the Humanimal lab assistants had reconstructed the Gene-Splicer, while Spider-Man had figured out the way to reverse the splicing properly. Christina was the first to be successfully unspliced from her pigeon, but Spider-Man explained that procedure was off-limits to Bailey, as the rest of his DNA was locked inside the Boy-Spider, whom Tabitha was still extremely protective of. She was the next to go through with the procedure and was separated from the cat who had been a part of her for many years, but still had no memory at all of Bailey. Everyone else was fixed as well, except for Boy-Spider, Hellifino and Jeremy, who were all subjects of non-standard splicing. They stayed behind at the Estate for the time, while Spider-Boy went back to New York City, remembering that he had a photo of himself with his mother as a proof of their connection back there.
powers: Due to the years they were merged into a single being, Tabitha is able to understand the cat speech of Tabby.

tabur.name: Tabur
tabur.origin: Tabur is an artificially evolved humanoid cat created by the scientist called the High Evolutionary as one of his New Men. Despite being disliked and barely tolerated by the other New Men, Tabur lived in the city of Wundagore alongside them. When war broke out between those New Men loyal to the High Evolutionary and the rebels who followed the evil Super-Beast, Tabur fled in cowardice. With help from Thor, the High Evolutionary defeated the rebels who were then banished into space. Tabur was still outside Wundagore when the city also left Earth. Being left alone in a hostile world of humans caused Tabur's mind to snap and he pledged his life to destruction, becoming a scavenger and throwback predator as he wandered the Earth. At some point during his wanderings, Tabur was found by the Cat People, an entire race of humanoid cats who had been created centuries earlier. The Cat People took Tabur in as one of their own and tried to reclaim him, but it didn't take and Tabur continued to feel like an outcast. He also became known to the Cat People as "the Renegade." After learning that Dr. Leon had created a device that could turn Tigra back into her original human form, Tabur saw a way that he could use it for his own purposes and plotted to steal it. When Dr. Joanne Tumolo, Tigra's mentor who was to receive the device, found out what Tabur was planning, he kidnapped her and held her captive to prevent her from warning her fellow Cat People. Tabur then went to the prearranged rendezvous point in New Orleans where he stalked and killed Richard Dannemiller and fled with the electro-genetic device. He then modified the device to change its function into one of evolutionary reversal, capable to transforming mammals into their prehistoric proto-forms. Realizing the danger that Tabur's plans posed to the Cat People, Dr. Tumolo sacrificed her life by using the Cat People's ability to briefly project a living image to a loved one (Tigra) in order to warn her about "the Renegade" and to tell her to warn the others that Tabur had the ray. By the time Tigra and the other Cat People in New Orleans had put the clues together, Tabur had already started his plan by using the ray to transform mammals from the local zoo and the surrounding Bayou country into their prehistoric proto-forms (mastadons, giant tapirs and prehistoric bears) which he then led on a rampage through the city. Knowing that the Cat People would be watching, Tabur publicly announced his plan to turn the entire human race into their less-intelligent simian ancestors so that the Cat-race could rule the planet and he would rule them. However, the Cat People rejected his plan and rose up against him, revealing themselves to the human world in the process, and began fighting against Tabur's prehistoric army alongside Tigra. When Tigra attacked Tabur, his greater strength enabled him to kick her away from him and he then used the ray on three of her Cat People allies to turn them into sabertooth tigers who would attack her. However, the transformed Cat People were not under his control and they continued to oppose him, turning the tide of the battle with Tabur's army. Tigra was able to attack Tabur again and separate him from the ray-gun which she then used to transform him back into his original form of a pussycat. The effects of the ray were not permanent and Tabur became his evolved self once again. Tabur then tried to find the Cat People but failed. Instead, he found his way into the Land Within, a dimension ruled by a related race of Cat People. Once there, he killed the king and, by their own laws, became their new monarch. Tabur also usurped the position of Balkatar, becoming the one who would hear the call if any sorcerer tried to summon the Balkatar to Earth. Planning to mate with Tigra in order to legitimize his rule, Tabur was searching for her when Agatha Harkness attempted to summon the Balkatar to save the seriously-wounded Tigra who had been in a feral and more bestial form for some time. Tabur heard the call and appeared before Harkness in Avengers Compound, then attacked her for being human vermin. Using a Cat's Head Amulet that he brought from the dimension of the Cat People, Tabur restored Tigra's mind and body to their previous states, and explained why he had done so. However, Tigra wasn't interested in mating with him, especially after seeing that he had attacked Mrs. Harkness, and rejected his offer, so Tabur decided to kill her instead. Since Tigra was still in a weakened state, their battle ended with her at his mercy, but before Tabur could use his claws to tear open her throat, Agatha Harkness cast a spell that transferred the dominant cat soul from Tigra to Tabur, changing him into an ordinary cat.
weapons: An electro-genetic device that could transform mammals into their prehistoric proto-forms

fields.history: Tabur is an artificially evolved humanoid cat created by the scientist called the High Evolutionary as one of his New Men. Despite being disliked and barely tolerated by the other New Men, Tabur lived in the city of Wundagore alongside them. When war broke out between those New Men loyal to the High Evolutionary and the rebels who followed the evil Super-Beast, Tabur fled in cowardice. With help from Thor, the High Evolutionary defeated the rebels who were then banished into space. Tabur was still outside Wundagore when the city also left Earth. Being left alone in a hostile world of humans caused Tabur's mind to snap and he pledged his life to destruction, becoming a scavenger and throwback predator as he wandered the Earth. At some point during his wanderings, Tabur was found by the Cat People, an entire race of humanoid cats who had been created centuries earlier. The Cat People took Tabur in as one of their own and tried to reclaim him, but it didn't take and Tabur continued to feel like an outcast. He also became known to the Cat People as "the Renegade." After learning that Dr. Leon had created a device that could turn Tigra back into her original human form, Tabur saw a way that he could use it for his own purposes and plotted to steal it. When Dr. Joanne Tumolo, Tigra's mentor who was to receive the device, found out what Tabur was planning, he kidnapped her and held her captive to prevent her from warning her fellow Cat People. Tabur then went to the prearranged rendezvous point in New Orleans where he stalked and killed Richard Dannemiller and fled with the electro-genetic device. He then modified the device to change its function into one of evolutionary reversal, capable to transforming mammals into their prehistoric proto-forms. Realizing the danger that Tabur's plans posed to the Cat People, Dr. Tumolo sacrificed her life by using the Cat People's ability to briefly project a living image to a loved one (Tigra) in order to warn her about "the Renegade" and to tell her to warn the others that Tabur had the ray. By the time Tigra and the other Cat People in New Orleans had put the clues together, Tabur had already started his plan by using the ray to transform mammals from the local zoo and the surrounding Bayou country into their prehistoric proto-forms (mastadons, giant tapirs and prehistoric bears) which he then led on a rampage through the city. Knowing that the Cat People would be watching, Tabur publicly announced his plan to turn the entire human race into their less-intelligent simian ancestors so that the Cat-race could rule the planet and he would rule them. However, the Cat People rejected his plan and rose up against him, revealing themselves to the human world in the process, and began fighting against Tabur's prehistoric army alongside Tigra. When Tigra attacked Tabur, his greater strength enabled him to kick her away from him and he then used the ray on three of her Cat People allies to turn them into sabertooth tigers who would attack her. However, the transformed Cat People were not under his control and they continued to oppose him, turning the tide of the battle with Tabur's army. Tigra was able to attack Tabur again and separate him from the ray-gun which she then used to transform him back into his original form of a pussycat. The effects of the ray were not permanent and Tabur became his evolved self once again. Tabur then tried to find the Cat People but failed. Instead, he found his way into the Land Within, a dimension ruled by a related race of Cat People. Once there, he killed the king and, by their own laws, became their new monarch. Tabur also usurped the position of Balkatar, becoming the one who would hear the call if any sorcerer tried to summon the Balkatar to Earth. Planning to mate with Tigra in order to legitimize his rule, Tabur was searching for her when Agatha Harkness attempted to summon the Balkatar to save the seriously-wounded Tigra who had been in a feral and more bestial form for some time. Tabur heard the call and appeared before Harkness in Avengers Compound, then attacked her for being human vermin. Using a Cat's Head Amulet that he brought from the dimension of the Cat People, Tabur restored Tigra's mind and body to their previous states, and explained why he had done so. However, Tigra wasn't interested in mating with him, especially after seeing that he had attacked Mrs. Harkness, and rejected his offer, so Tabur decided to kill her instead. Since Tigra was still in a weakened state, their battle ended with her at his mercy, but before Tabur could use his claws to tear open her throat, Agatha Harkness cast a spell that transferred the dominant cat soul from Tigra to Tabur, changing him into an ordinary cat.
weapons: An electro-genetic device that could transform mammals into their prehistoric proto-forms
fields.notes: At the time that was written and published, the Cat People who had been Tigra's allies against Tabur were supposedly extinct. However, the writers of that story apparently did not understand the distinction between Tigra's allies and the Cat People from the Land Within, and so wrote their story as if the Cat People of whom the Balkatar was a member were the same Cat People who had opposed Tabur. This continuity error was later resolved when the profile on the Cat People presented in established that, instead of being wiped out, Tigra's allies had actually gone into hiding in another dimension, and that Tabur had accidentally found the Land Within where the other Cat People lived while hunting for Tigra's allies.

tachyon.name: Tachyon

tacky armondo.origin: Tacky Armondo was a wizard who summoned the barbarian Moanin' to his castle and requested Moanin' to collect a list of ingredients for his latest spell. Moanin' reluctantly accepted after Tacky used his magic on him. At some point Tacky converted to and 5 years later, Moanin returned and Tacky told him to just throw the ingredients away. Moanin' was angered by this, crafted a bazooka and destroyed Tacky's home.

tad carter.name: Tad Carter
tad carter.origin: Tad Carter discovered his power to move objects telekinetically at the age of 12. A few years later he read his teachers mind; this was the first time he realized he had a second power. His powers continued to develop. When he was in college, not understanding what he was, he believed he could teach others to use the same abilities he had. After telling several other boys about his ability to read minds they attacked him, calling him a mutant. When they approached him he telekinetically pushed them away. He was at this point levitated by an unknown mutant who telepathically spoke to him. He was flown away by this mutant and told that he must wait with them in hiding until mankind is ready for them. Tad's rescuer was later revealed to be named Tobias Messenger, who had founded a group of mutants called the Promise. Along with the other members of the Promise, Carter slept in suspended animation for ten years at a time, emerging for a few weeks each decade to seek out new members. They planned to wait until mutants and humans went to war, which they saw as inevitable, and then provide guidance to the mutants who they believed would be victorious.
powers: Mind-reading

family: Brad Carter (father, presumed deceased) Unnamed mother (presumed deceased)

tad sheen.name: Tad Sheen
tad sheen.origin: Tad Sheen was a janitor at Randolph Tech with a passion for chemistry. He thought he had discovered a mixture of products that if mixed in the right proportions and in the right environment could make you travel through time. He tried this reaction in the school laboratory before classes began but it seemed that nothing happened other than the mixture exploded dirtying the laboratory table. While cleaning he fell very tired and made him doze off waking up again in the laboratory but in 1760. He had traveled to the past and not the future as he thought. He tried to explain to Professor Moorehead that he had been in the future and the wonders that would be discovered in the years, but the Professor thought he had a great imagination and wanted to introduce him to Professor Gorman to make him become a writer. In the meantime they were attacked by Indians and immediately Tad bravely faced them but was hit on the head and fainted. He was awakened with water by student John Lovejoy who told him to be careful with his experiments in the laboratory or he would be thrown out of school. He returned in 1956 and thought that what he had experienced was only a dream but soon after he found himself near an inscription that proclaimed a certain "Professor Abner Moorhead" as the first professor of Physical Science at the school and in his hands he found himself with an Indian arrowhead.

tadashi fujita.name: Tadashi Fujita
tadashi fujita.origin: Tadashi Fujita and his colleague Ramon Lipschitz were brilliant college students with a research grant and faculties near Coney Island. They took on Alphonsus Lefszycic as a lab assiatant whom they nicknamed Gomi was asked to be their lab assistant. Their experiments, using cybernetics to enhance beings, resulted in the creation of augmented abilities, human-level intelligence and strength and the ability to project small illusions for communication in a pair of lobsters. Gomi named the lobsters Bill and Don. The two scientists were infatuated with the superheroine Marvel Girl, and were upset when she transformed into the Phoenix. Intending to create their own Marvel Girl by kidnapping a girl and implanting cybernetics in her, the scientists first experimented on Gomi himself, trying to bestow telekinetic abilities. They failed, however, in that Gomi's cybernetics simply produced a destructive and uncontrollable bolt of kinetic energy. The two scientists left, fearing an inspection on their studies.

tadzio de santis.name: Tadzio de Santis
tadzio de santis.origin: Tadzio de Santis was born in Italy. He was noted as a gifted child, first seen with his parents and extended family playing an arpeggio for them on the piano. In 1936, the fascist regime was looking for a volunteer for their "super soldier" program. Tadzio's intelligence made him the ideal candidate for this program, and the fascists conscripted him whether he liked it or not. The happy family gathering was interrupted by soldiers, who gunned down Tadzio's parents, siblings and other relatives, and took the boy to Fortress Lorenzo. Japanese and German officers were there alongside Italian politicians, who were interested in their proposal of a "super soldier" project. The fascists introduced Dr. Maria Vaseilli, who had discovered ways to alter DNA. To prove her point, they demonstrated a rat they experimented on, which had grown twice as big in two weeks. However the rat had become hairless and discolored red. Soldiers then forced the young Tadzio into a chair, where they fastened a brainwashing device on his head and forcibly administered a vaccine, to the horror of Dr. Vasilli. Aghast by what she had done, Dr. Vasilli fled Fortress Lorenzo, eventually making her way to the United States. Seven years later, the boy became the Red Skull and planned to launch a missile at the White House as a so called "gift" to President Roosevelt. The launch was shortly interrupted by a initial fight between Captain America and the Red Skull. The Red Skull defeated Captain America while his hero Mussolini was watching. He strapped Captain America to the rocket, who managed to do as well with his enemy. The Red Skull was forced to cut off his own hand to prevent himself from being taken along with the missile. After the war, the Red Skull underwent extensive plastic surgery in a particularly successful attempt to alter his disfigured features. He also raised a daughter who became head of a crime family. thumb|right|"Tadzio de Santis" In the 1960's, an American industrial complex hired the Red Skull and his thugs to assassinate President Kimball. They had already assassinated John F. Kennedy, Dr. Martin Luther King, and Robert Kennedy. After finding a videotape, Captain America learned the Red Skull's origin and assaulted his castle. In the midst of their battle, the Red Skull pulled out a remote trigger for an explosive device, but Captain America used the recording of the murder of the Red Skull's family to distract him. While the Red Skull was lost in thought, Captain America used his shield to send the Red Skull off a cliff before the bomb could be set off.

tae.name: Tae
tae.origin: Tae was a God to an unknown people, along with Pennsu. Together, they ruled with cruelty, expecting massive signs of faith, and rewarding them with indifference and cataclysms. Desak, Destroyer of Gods, on his gods-killing crusade, came to them but was stopped by Thor, Hercules, and Beta Ray Bill. Watching the fight, the cruel Tae and Pennsu decided to bring death upon them and their worshippers, intending to find new ones. Desak, Thor, Hercules, and Beta Ray Bill then realigned against them, Tae overpowering Hercules. While Thor managed to save the mortals, Desak assassinated Tae and Pennsu. They were replaced in their worshippers' faith by Thor, to Desak's displeasure (but who were accepted by Thor, despite the fact he hadn't asked for their faith).
powers: Tae and Pennsu were able to immense pink energy blasts by bonding together (he was also able to blast energy on his own), and were allegedly able to to fall, to the extent of causing a flood. He proved able to best Hercules in combat.

tae won.name: Tae-Won
tae won.species: Human Mutate; accidentally exposed to energy generated by the Psylot Gem through an Amplifier created by Dr. Phineas Horton
tae won.origin: ===Origin=== The man that would become Tae-Won was born in a small village around 1950, at the start of the Korean War. His birth mother was killed during a skirmish, leaving him an orphan until a young girl found him. The girl, who had also lost her brother, decided to take the baby and named him after her missing brother, Tae-Won. Seven years later, Tae-Won now lived with the girl, who he referred to as his aunt. Their life went on normally until one day when Tae-Won was walking back home he saw a vendor selling at the market. He wanted to eat it but had no money to buy it. It was then that he met a young delinquent named Min-Jae who persuaded Tae to steal a bowl. Even though Tae-Won knew what he was doing was wrong, the naive boy did what Min-Jae asked. Min-Jae appointed himself as Tae-Won's "older brother" and referred to themselves as the Kal Duo. Their criminal streak continued into their teenage years, when in 1966 the Kal Duo committed a heist at a store, with Tae-Won serving as a distraction while Min-Jae stole money from the counter, but they got caught and were forced to run away while the shopkeeper continued to chase them. They deliberately lured the shopkeeper into an alley where their friends were waiting to gang up on him, forcing the shopkeeper to flee. Back at home, Tae was confronted by his aunt, who scolded him since she already knew what he was doing. She pleaded with Tae to stop his criminal activities, but he reasoned that he was doing all that to help their economy. After a heated argument, his aunt asked Tae to choose between stopping his criminal activities or leaving the house. Feeling offended by his aunt's words, he finally chose to leave. By 1978 the Kal Duo had expanded their criminal activities into a powerful crime syndicate. Learning that the South Korean government and the US Department of Defense were working on a top secret joint-project in Hanam, Tae-Won led a raid of the facility hosting the project to steal the pricey equipment. While attempting to strip a machine that was empowered by a magical gem, Tae-Won got trapped by a restraining device while the machine activated. Min-Jae and their lackeys were forced to abandon Tae-Won as the machine fired a full blast of energy onto him, which destroyed the facility and left Min-Jae believing Tae-Won perished. However, Tae-Won miraculously survived with no injuries or ill effects from the explosion and even gained a tall, muscular physique. The authorities returned him to his aunt's care. Tae-Won eventually discovered that he gained superpowers from the incident, including superhuman strength, flight, slowed aging and other abilities. Tae-Won's aunt helped him learn how to harness his powers and showed him one of his former lackeys violently extorting a neighbor for money. Since then, Tae-Won committed himself to helping people and to atone for his criminal past, and continued doing so after his aunt's death. Tae-Won took on the name Taeguki and was recognized as the national hero of South Korea and the field leader and heart of the Tiger Division, South-Korea's government-sanctioned superhuman response team. Still feeling that his heroic actions alone were inadequate, Tae-Won personally recruited the other members of the Tiger Division, hoping that they could make more of a difference than him. However, Tae-Won did not disclose his criminal past to his teammates out of shame. At some point in the past after making his public debut with the Tiger Division, Tae-Won disappeared in the Quad Dimension and returned decades later. Twenty years before the present, Tae-Won attempted to apprehend telepathic serial killer Wrenley Fischer and tracked him down to his boat in the ocean with two kidnapped victims. Fischer threw one hostage overboard and while Tae-Won was preoccupied with rescuing her, Fischer killed his other hostage. Tae-Won destroyed Fischer's boat, but Fischer hit his head and drowned before Tae-Won could capture him. Tae-Won was haunted by his failure to save Fischer's last victim and for not bringing Fischer to justice. ===Tiger Division=== When Taskmaster sought to infiltrate the Tiger Division Base in Buramsan Mountain to copy the kinesic signature of NIS director Ami Han, he ratted out a group of local terrorists to the authorities, shrunk himself using Pym Particles and rode back to base on Taegukgi's neck after he defeated them. Once the intruder was found in the air vents Taegukgi fired an energy beam into the ventilation shaft but didn't hit Taskmaster, who managed to escape. thumb|left|Tiger Division fighting a controlled Taegukgi As part of a plan to stage a coup, a gangster family called the Choi Faction provided the body-snatcher villain Mongdal a power boost to take over Taegukgi's body. They threatened to let him loose on Seoul if the government didn't cede control to them. In response, Tiger Division led an attack on their base. While Mongdal used Taegukgi's body to defeat most of the team in a quick ba
