tai well of all things.name: Tai (Well of All Things)
tai well of all things.origin: Centuries ago, Tai's ancestors settled in Cambodia around an interdimensional breach called the Well of All Things. Calling themselves the Cult of the Dragon's Breath they plotted to one day rule the world. Through centuries of selective breeding, their plan began to bear fruit with Tai's generation. Tai and the fellow members of the cult that were born in her generation were able to tap into the powers of the well. Tai's people prophesied that in order for their plan for world conquest to come true, the members of the cult would eventually need to marry westerners, and that these children would become the eventual rulers of the world. Only through the merging of east and west could the prophecy come true. Tai, ever the opportunist, did not want to share the power with anyone. Over time she murdered the majority of her cult with the exception of her daughter Miyami and 5 other brides of the Dragon's Breath Cult and she waited for the prophecy to be fulfilled. Eventually, Tai's patience was rewarded during the Siancong War. An American unit of soldiers called the Half-Fulls found the temple of the Dragon's Breath Cult during a walk through the jungle of Cambodia. The group attacked Tai until they were restrained by her magic. Tai made the six soldiers a pact: marry the six brides of the Dragon's Breath Cult and they would be the fathers to the eventual rulers of the world. Five of the six members of the Half Fulls accepted Tai's pact. Andrew Chord married Tai's daughter Miyami and they had two children, Midnight's Fire and Silhouette. Go Vin Ng and his bride became the parents of Silk Fever. Collier Mack and his bride became the parents of Smiling Tiger. Mack Conroy and his bride became the parents of Bloodstrike. Diego Casseas and his bride became the parents of an unnamed girl. The sixth member of the Half Fulls, Daryl Taylor refused to marry a bride of the cult because he already had a wife named Melody back home in the states (in an ironic twist Daryl would break his vows to Melody later and father an illegitimate son named Donyell). Daryl's refusal to participate in the pact is what ultimately led to his and Melody's murder at the hands of Andrew Chord. After Miyami faked the deaths of herself and her two children Chord wandered the world as a mercenary eventually reuniting with his mother-in-law Tai. Tai, fearful that the pact would come undone by the lack of participation of its members, came with Chord to America. Tai had Andrew Chord reconnect with his old war buddy Daryl Taylor. Daryl and Melody's son Dwayne Taylor in many ways became a replacement for the son Chord had lost. Tai eventually ordered Chord to kill Daryl and Melody which he did. At this point, Dwayne Taylor was introduced to Tai and she used her mental powers to cloud his memory of what happened to his parents. Tai and Chord became Dwayne's legal guardians and thus held power at Daryl Taylor's company the Taylor Foundation. Dwayne was traumatized by the murder of his parents and began to wage a war against crime while Tai and Chord supported him in this endeavor to suit their own agenda. Dwayne soon joined Midnight's Fire and Silhouette in fighting gangs in New York. Tai and Chord did not realize that Dwayne's new partners were Chord's children or Tai's grandchildren. Tai and Chord took an immediate dislike to Midnight's Fire and Silhouette. This partnership ended with Silhouette being shot while trying to infiltrate a gang which ruined Midnight's Fire and Dwayne's friendship. Some time later Dwayne Taylor decided to build himself a suit of armor, took the codename Night Thrasher, and began gathering a group of super humans to help him in his war against crime. Tai and Chord were often helpful to the group. Tai herself took on a team of Hellions before being subdued by the White Queen. Tai's granddaughter Silhouette was the first member to join the team after the six founders. Eventually, Night Thrasher and Silhouette began to uncover Chord and Tai's mismanagement of the Taylor Foundation and discovered that the Foundation's money was supporting various questionable recipients such as Justin Hammer, Roxxon, Genetech, Arnim Zola and AIM. When confronted, Chord attempted suicide by shooting himself in the head. Tai eventually used her magic to heal him as best she could. Later, when Chord was in the hospital, he was visited by his wife Miyami. Tai later tracked Miyami to a Chinese restaurant and when Miyami admitted her son and daughter were still alive and that she faked their deaths to keep them from Tai, Tai then realized that Silhouette and Midnight's Fire were her grandchildren when Miyami mentioned the children grew up in Chinatown. Enraged she murdered Miyami and later attempted to kill Silhouette. Tai returned to Cambodia and was confronted by the Folding Circle. Diego Casseas, now calling himself the Left Hand, had gathered together the children of the Half Fulls (except Silhouette) in order to defeat Tai and claim the Well of

Even though he was saved by the intervention of Rachel Van Helsing, the attack left him with his throat mutilated and mute, his wife Jyota in a wheelchair and his son Adri infected with vampirism. takeo fukuda.origin: Takeo Fukuda was the Prime Minister of Japan from 1976 to 1978. His appearance should be considered topical references per the Sliding Timescale of Earth-616. ===Apocryphal Appearances=== The Prime Minister of Japan, identified as Takeo Fukuda, met with Osama and other high-ranking members of the Japanese government after terrorist Moses Magnum demanded the surrender of the government to him, then destroyed Agarashima as proof of his power. At Osama's request, the Prime Minister summoned American agency Nightwing Restorations to help, and Nightwing discovered Magnum's secret base. Fukuda and Osama then agreed to recruit visiting American superheroes X-Men and send them to defeat Magnum - Fukuda had already informed the Emperor that Japan would not submit to Magnum. The X-Men and Japanese superhero Sunfire defeated Magnum.

takkor.name: Takkor
takkor.origin: thumb|left The being known as Takkor appeared to be a four-armed, red-skinned, skull-faced semi-humanoid who rode a winged horse-like creature from an unspecified alien world. However, "Takkor" was actually nothing more than a manikin that was carried by the horse-like creature who was able to somehow operate the manikin's arms and to telepathically speak through his supposed rider. At some point, Takkor was chosen to be one of the six pawns that would be used by the Prime Mover in his contest with the Grandmaster. During the first round of the game, Takkor was paired with the bat-like Chiroptera and they were both transported to an alien world where jagged spires of stone jutted up through purple mists toward a fiery orange sky. Finding themselves facing the Valkyrie (astride her winged horse Aragorn) and Nighthawk, Chiroptera struck first, diving down at Nighthawk, hurling him into the swirling mists below and pursuing him into those mists. Once the other two were out of the way, the alien steed and rider attacked the Valkyrie. As the rider used the weapons in three of his hands to attack while the shield on his fourth arm defended, the steed made it appear as if the rider was speaking telepathically to the Valkyrie, identifying himself as Takkor, "He who cannot die!" Despite having fewer weapons, the Valkyrie was soon able to use her sword Dragonfang to slice off the rider's head, but the mount immediately dived down after the falling severed head, flying beneath it so that the headless body could catch the head and set it back in place. As Takkor and his mount rose skyward again to resume the battle, Valkyrie realized that it was the steed which was truly Takkor and that the apparent rider was just a manikin, so she threw Dragonfang into the horse-like creature's chest, impaling him. Wailing its death-cry, both he and his manikin rider apparently plummeted to their deaths in the mists below. When Nighthawk also defeated his foe, the Grandmaster's pawns won the first round.

fields.history: thumb|left The being known as Takkor appeared to be a four-armed, red-skinned, skull-faced semi-humanoid who rode a winged horse-like creature from an unspecified alien world. However, "Takkor" was actually nothing more than a manikin that was carried by the horse-like creature who was able to somehow operate the manikin's arms and to telepathically speak through his supposed rider. At some point, Takkor was chosen to be one of the six pawns that would be used by the Prime Mover in his contest with the Grandmaster. During the first round of the game, Takkor was paired with the bat-like Chiroptera and they were both transported to an alien world where jagged spires of stone jutted up through purple mists toward a fiery orange sky. Finding themselves facing the Valkyrie (astride her winged horse Aragorn) and Nighthawk, Chiroptera struck first, diving down at Nighthawk, hurling him into the swirling mists below and pursuing him into those mists. Once the other two were out of the way, the alien steed and rider attacked the Valkyrie. As the rider used the weapons in three of his hands to attack while the shield on his fourth arm defended, the steed made it appear as if the rider was speaking telepathically to the Valkyrie, identifying himself as Takkor, "He who cannot die!" Despite having fewer weapons, the Valkyrie was soon able to use her sword Dragonfang to slice off the rider's head, but the mount immediately dived down after the falling severed head, flying beneath it so that the headless body could catch the head and set it back in place. As Takkor and his mount rose skyward again to resume the battle, Valkyrie realized that it was the steed which was truly Takkor and that the apparent rider was just a manikin, so she threw Dragonfang into the horse-like creature's chest, impaling him. Wailing its death-cry, both he and his manikin rider apparently plummeted to their deaths in the mists below. When Nighthawk also defeated his foe, the Grandmaster's pawns won the first round.
equipment: Takkor's rider was a manikin whose four arms Takkor could somehow control, albeit awkwardly.
weapons: Takkor's rider wielded a sword, a mace, an axe and a shield.
fields.notes: The profile on the Prime Mover that was presented in stated that all six of his pawns who appeared in were extraterrestrial mercenaries who were native to Reality-691. This was never been confirmed in any story. Although doesn't make it clear if Takkor was the winged creature's real name or just an alias that it used for its rider, the profile on the Intimidators from does mention "the horse-like Takkor." Although the Valkyrie seemingly had to sacrifice her enchanted sword Dragonfang in order to defeat Takkor, an editorial reply on the letters page in stated that Val's sword had been restored to her by the Grandmaster.

tako shamara ancestor.name: Tako Shamara (Ancestor)
tako shamara ancestor.first_appearance: Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe A to Z Update Vol 1 4
tako shamara ancestor.origin: ===Death=== In 1592, a giant creature named the Wani came from the Ocean off Japan's coast and went on a rampage, and was seen as a sign of the sea god Susanoo's displeasure. The Samurai general Tako Shamara, tainted by the shame of his failures to kill the Wani, stole a Westerner's ship and used the gunpowder he found aboard to force the Wani back into the abyss, at the cost of his life. ===Legacy=== As the Wani's death was uncertain, and the honor of the Shamara family remained tainted. Tako's son Kiri trained with sorcerers, and that knowledge was passed from a generation to another. The last to wield that powers, named Tako Shamara as well, was killed by KIA, and his own son swore to took up the mantle.
weapons: The gunpowder present on the stolen ship.
weaknesses: Too much influenced by his honor.

family: Mary, Dragon Lord's Son, Dragon Lord's father, Tako, Tako Shamara II (descendants)

taku pict.name: Taku (Pict)
taku pict.origin: Taku was the chieftain and the king of the Picts of the Pictish Isles during the Pre-Cataclysmic Age circa 18,500 BC. He lived at the Central Pict Isle. When the Atlantean Royal Barge, carrying Atlantean chieftain Lhok-Nor's daughter Sareena who was to met with King Kull of Valusia and potentially marry her to forge an alliance between their kingdoms (a plan devised by Councilor Tu against Kull's wishes), passed near the Pictish Isles, Taku decided not to attack it, but vowed he would bring war to Valusia if Kull was to ally with the Atlanteans. After Sareena was murdered in the City of Wonders by what appeared as an Atlantean (in fact a Wolf Man), Taku was said that Tu attempted to salvage the alliance, and unaware Atlantis was also going at war with Valusia, consequently ordered his men to invade Valusia, and attacked the capital. Kull persuaded him and Lhok-Nor to venture into the catacombs beneath the city and discover the real threat for the human race represented by the Wolf-Men. Recognizing his true allies, Taku agreed to help him defeat the Demonolater, leader of the Wolf-Men, and ended the war.
weapons: Sword

talan.name: Talan
talan.origin: Talan was a member of the Atlantean Royal Family. He was married to Namora, the cousin of King Namor. Due to her Hybrid nature she was unable to conceive naturally with her husband, much to their disappointment. Namora tracked down the rogue scientist Vyrra and asked him for help. He cloned Namora and placed the child in her womb so to appear as she was born naturally. Not knowing how his daughter Namorita was actually conceived, believing she was his own. When Namor went missing in the '50s, Namora searched for him to no avail. In 1961, Namora and her family left Atlantis for the colony of Maritanis. Soon afterward, Talan was killed in an atomic bomb test, and Namora took their child to live in Lemuria.

talia kruma.name: Talia Kruma
talia kruma.origin: Talia Kruma was a brilliant engineer, architect and designer and a member of the Whiz Kids, a group of scientists working for Bill Foster at Stark International in Los Angeles. She was a very private person, an enigma even to her friends, which was due to her feeling guilt over her lover Neil's death. During a holiday in Bangkok, Talia and her lover Neil were involved in a violent incident in the jungle. Talia fled for her life, leaving Neil behind. Afterwards, she became more introverted and secretive. The Whiz Kids were assigned to create a device which would create personal force-fields for police personnel. They presented their prototype in a demonstration, but Talia had to explain that it was still unstable. Foster asked the Whiz Kids to create a sensor device for radiation, which he intended to use against the Atom Smasher. Talia was initially lost in thought, and was urged to get to work by Dale West. The team soon completed the device. West was attracted to Talia. He playfully kissed her during their banter, but she slapped him and walked away. Recalling her role in the apparent death of Neil, she cried while alone in an underground parking. During an attack at her workplace by Vulcan and his henchmen, Talia was physically assaulted. The Whiz Kids were surprised when informed that Foster was about to resign, due to a personal argument with Tony Stark. Foster and the Whiz Kids worked on a space suit intended for a manned mission of exploration to the planet Venus. During a test for their prototype, their workplace was attacked by the Hijacker. Along with most of the staff, Talia was incapacitated with knockout gas. At Stark West, the Whiz Kids were visited by Foster and the Thing. One of the company's warehouses was looted by the Atom Smasher. Talia and the other scientists provided assistance to the Thing. When the Whiz Kids examined the list of stolen items, they realized that Atom Smasher was planning to build a bomb. Later, the Whiz Kids visited Foster at the hospital, where he was recovering from radiation poisoning. They were hopeful that Foster will rejoin them in working for Stark West. Talia switched jobs at some point, and started working for Project: Pegasus. She was interviewed by a reporter concerning the origins and abilities of the Quantum Bands. Having never examined the items in person, Talia could only provide educated guesses. She also mentioned her theory on the origin of Mjolnir, which she viewed as a terrestrial object instead of an extradimensional weapon. Captain America and Edwin Jarvis listed Talia among the intended members of the new Avengers Support Crew. She was scheduled to be a resident scientist for the team. Talia started working for Starcore's manned satellite. She met with Quasar to inform him that there was an increase in solar flares, which she attributed to the effects of a Shi'ar stargate. Quasar suggested evacuating the satellite, but nobody wanted to abort its mission. He provided Talia with a special frequency to contact him in case of an emergency. Talia and other crewmembers escaped the satellite on a lifepod when it was severely damaged by a solar flare. Quasar led several members of the Avengers on a rescue mission, but the lifepod was rocked by the energies released by the passage of a Shi'ar armada through a wormhole. The Avengers and the Shi'ar briefly fought each other, before the Avengers resumed their rescue operation.

talia warroad.name: Talia Warroad
talia warroad.origin: left|200px|thumb Talia Warroad was a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, reassigned to the FBI's Paranormal Unit. She was first tasked with investigating unusual supernatural activity throughout North America. Since Talia was a young child, she had experienced horrid supernatural premonitions. While traveling through Utah, she got her first vision of Johnathon "Johnny" Blaze as a flaming skull. Later, she came across a motel engulfed in flames and a flame trail left by Johnny. While still in Idaho, Talia stopped at a garage where she performed a ritual to summon Zeb. Zeb admitted he had been attempting to thwart Talia's mission. Zeb summoned crows and broke free of the summoning circle before being knocked out by a now demonized Whilmer. Wilmer took both Talia and Zeb to the unknown cemetery. A fight ensued between Alabaster and Zeb, allowing Talia to escape. Talia, magically disguised as a waitress, first made contact with Johnny at a diner in Colorado. Afterwards, she confined Johnny in a motel room and magically read his memory. Realizing they were similar, Talia and Johnny decided to team up and eventually became lovers. Talia and Johnny traveled to Chicago, however, they were attacked mid-route by Exhaust's minions. Further investigation led Talia and Johnny to a subway train with innocent people trapped inside. Johnny left to save the innocent people on the train while Talia was confronted by Exhaust. Talia and Johnny battled Exhaust before escaping to confront Blackheart. During the fights, Talia exhibited significant magical ability. Talia and Johnny traveled through the south, confronting several demonic entities. While in Georgia, Talia was almost killed by Johnny's bike. Outside Savannah, GA, Talia cast a spell on police officers to allow her entry into the Necropolis. Later, after the fight at Necropolis, Talia performed a séance using Johnny's blood. The investigation led Talia to a club in Myrtle Beach, SC. While investigating, Talia learned Danny Ketch had something to do with the massive loss of life at the club. Talia traveled to Georgetown Hospital and then to a data center in search of clues regarding Danny. Talia and Johnny tracked the whereabouts of Danny to Infernal Labs in California.
powers: Talia is able to cast multiple magical spells.
abilities: Premonition

talionis.name: Talionis
talionis.origin: Sister Talionis was a Skrull separatist that despised the Skrull Empire's union with the Kree Imperium into the Kree/Skrull Alliance. In order to amass power to strike against her enemies, she entered into an alliance with Doctor Doom. She became the leader of the Brethren of the Forgotten Flame, a cult modeled after the prehistoric Skrull fire cults, and turned its worship to Dormammu, with promises to use his power to destroy the universe. Swaying Ego the Living Planet to the Brethren's cause, Sister Talionis had him displace to a specific location in the Galactic Rim to follow a prophetic ritual that required them to observe a constellation comprised of the brightest stars in three separate Skrullian constellations. When the time came, Talionis directed the rest of the Brethren of the Forgotten Flame in a self-sacrificial ritual to make Dormammu take possession of Ego. In turn, Dormammu embarked on a campaign of conquest, and one of the planets he targeted was Chitauri Prime. When Doctor Doom allied himself with the Guardians of the Galaxy to stop Dormammu, he freed Chitauri Prime. In the aftermath of Dormammu's defeat, Sister Talionis stepped in to become the new Chitauri Queen as she and Doom had arranged, so that she could build an army and eventually strike against the Alliance. However, her reign was short lived, as the Cult of Knull came to Chitauri Prime and conquered it. Sister Talonis was forcibly taken over by a symbiote and--when she refused to submit--slain and reanimated to spawn new symbiotes with which to infest the rest of the Chitauri.

tally emmett.name: Tally Emmett
tally emmett.origin: Tally Emmett was a young woman from Citrusville who became romantically involved with Kip Powers. Because of the ongoing animosity between their families, the pair decided to run away together into the nearby swamps. Believing their disappearance would force their parents to cooperate and perhaps reconcile, Tally and Kip left messages revealing where they had gone. Instead, when the families met during the search, their mutual hatred only intensified. Frightened by the escalating confrontation, Tally fled deeper into the swamp and accidentally fell into a patch of quicksand. Although her father attempted to rescue her, he was unable to reach her in time, and she drowned. Her death devastated Kip Powers, who shortly afterward took his own life.

tama janowitz.name: Tama Janowitz
tama janowitz.origin: Tama Janowitz was born in San Francisco, California to a psychiatrist father and literature professor mother who divorced when she was ten. Janowitz then moved to the East Coast of the United States. While there she attended Barnard College and the Columbia University School of the Arts and started writing about life in New York City. Janowitz was on the same book signing tour as Peter Parker and his book Webs. While in San Diego she appeared alongside him and Louis Baxter III on a television chat show. Parker complimented her on her book and her weird dress sense. She invited Parker to dinner at the Hotel they were staying at. When the Hotel restaurant was shut down for health code violations they ended up eating cold chips and soggy hamburgers at a bus stop. Later she spotted him signing books and invited him for lunch.

tamara brides of mitra.name: Tamara (Brides of Mitra)
tamara brides of mitra.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 53: Conan the Barbarian in The Skull of Set
tamara brides of mitra.origin: ===Origin=== Tamara was one of the Brides of Mitra during the Hyborian Age of Conan (10,000 BC). She was set at a temple of Mitra in an unnamed city in Eastern Argos. ===Eidoran=== Circa 15,500 BC, the people of Eidoran worshiped Set and summoned demons, including Set's servant Khorus. The demons were eventually bound by a sorcerer hired by the first followers of Mithra, sealed in stone using the Skull of Set (a crystal skull with a ruby on its forehead) as a focus of power for his spell (and the key to free Khorus as well). Eventually, the city laid in ruins, literally cut off from the rest of the world as the city stood on a plateau surrounded by a trench, and located in Argos, guarded by the Followers of Mitra. As Koth attacked Argos, soldiers heading for the eastern front slaughtered the guards on the way, save for one who staggered into an Eastern Argos temple of Mitra. Tamara was sent with the next departing coach, in hope of reaching the ruins before the followers of Set. Posing as a simple priestess of Mitra, she joined the coach of aristocrats Lord Arides and Lady Vasallia, and merchant Borondo, fleeing the Kothian advance in Eastern Argos (though Borondo was in fact a spy for the Kothians). On their way out of the city, their wagon was close to crash into Conan's, who was delivering crown jewels, including the Key, the Skull of Set. Conan had a glimpse and Tamara, and immediately sensed her absence of panic, and identified her as a priestess. During the travel, Borondo questioned Tamara's presence, but both aristocrats dismissed his questions. The crash had an accident after Arides asked the aske to go faster. Tamara and Vassalia exchanged a brief theological conversation, before they were joined by Conan, sole survivor of his own wagon. Joining their paths, they ended up in the ruins of Eidoran while fleeing from hillmen bandits. The next morning, a party of Argosseans attacked, as one member was accused of being a traitor, and they were to kill all members of the caravan. Though Conan was guaranteed safety and escort to perform his mission, he suspected he would be executed as well, and refused to surrender his fellow travelers. Instants later, a priest of Set entered the city as well, called by Khorus, who had sensed the "key" being near. He was killed by Tamara, but forced his blood to carry his life's will into Lady Vasallia, who then took the skull, while his sorcery his sorcery "removed" the bottom of the chasm surrounding Eidoran, trapping anyone there. The demons were soon returned to flesh and battled Conan and Tamara, while Khorus himself was restored, causing ruins to collapse. Using a column fallen across the chasm, Arides came across and tried to plead his case to the Argosseans, but was executed. Some of the soldiers tried to pass across the chasm but fell into the pit due the demon struggling, causing the plateau to quake. "Vasallia" was beheaded by Tamara, and heroes and demon fought for the skull. Conan used it, smeared with his own blood, to blast Khorus into pieces and into the pit. Borondo was then exposed as the spy by Conan, and forced to flee. Filling his purses with some of the jewels, Conan departed after greeting Tamara, now the sole guard of Eidoran.

tamara blake.name: Tamara Blake
tamara blake.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 4
tamara blake.origin: Tamara was a young thief who got rescued from jail by Black Fox due to her good reputation. Alongside Felicia Hardy, she was then taught by the Black Fox in the arts of thievery, but, despite being better than Felicia at everything, Black Fox still favored Felicia. When she asked Fox about it, he told her the secret was that she faced everything, even crime, with joy, while Tamara was only at it for the money. 180px|thumb|left|Young Tamara Later, while discussing their different approaches to life with Felicia, Tamara surprised her with a kiss, and the two became romantically involved. Years in the future, while trying to spend the night with her then-boyfriend Spider-Man, Black Cat saw that the carafe he had given her had gone missing. After a lengthy search, Black Cat finally confronted the thief only to realize it was Tamara. After this, Tamara joined Felicia and Spider-Man at Felicia's apartment for the evening. When Tamara heard of Black Fox's death, she swore to avenge him no matter what. After finding out Felicia was the one who'd killed him, she was heartbroken, but it didn't change her mind, as she embarked on a journey to kill her using the stolen Iron Cat Armor. When the Sunset Bain A.I. she had enlisted to help her turned on her, however, Tamara was forced to work alongside Felicia and Tony Stark to stop her plans of world domination. In the end, she patched things up with Felicia, as she realized Felicia had been left with no choice but to kill their mentor. Amidst the chaos of the final confrontation with Sunset Bain, Tamara escaped and contacted Ceres Goldstein to help her fix the damaged Armor.

tamara fleet.name: Tamara Fleet
tamara fleet.origin: Tamara Fleet was originally romantically involved with Michael Fleet, but after his disappearance and apparent death, she found herself attracted to his brother Jonas. The two searched for the Wendigo, whom Tamara believed to be responsible for her former lover's death. After the two had apprehended the creature, it recognized Tamara, calling out to her in its bestial grunts. It then escaped into New York City. Once Tamara found out that Jonas had kept his knowledge of the Wendigo actually being Michael from her, she grew cold towards him. When last seen, she was accompanying the captured Wendigo into custody/treatment.

tamara rahn.name: Tamara Rahn
tamara rahn.origin: Tamara Rahn was an extraterrestrial and member of the water-breathing Banari race from planet Laab. The planet was destroyed, but she escaped on a craft which headed for the oceans of Earth. The last survivors of the planet were killed by the native Atlanteans who mistook them for invaders. Namor returned to Atlantis, and was introduced by Vashti to Tamara and her cause. The Atlanteans helped repair her space ship and send her on her way. Seeking revenge for the death of her people, she turned her ship's weapons on Atlantis forcing a confrontation with Namor. Namor subdued her and destroyed her ship. Tamara threw herself at the mercy of Vashti and was put under the guardianship of Namor. A pompous and arrogant Atlantean soldier, Lorvex, made a pass at Tamara who rebuked his advances. She was later caught in a fishing net and eventually brought to New York City. Namor learned of her capture and made his way there only to be challenged by Thor. Namor engaged Thor but was defeated by the Thunder God. Namor returned home to ponder a full-scale invasion of the surface world. Namor put his trust in Lorvex to assemble a force which Namor would lead against the surface dwellers to free Tamara. The invasion was a success in providing a daunting show of force, but Namor was unable to find Tamara as she had been rescued by Lorvex who decided to keep her as a hostage and continue the onslaught against the surface world. Namor defeated Lorvex and rescued Tamara. He then called off the surface attack and after addressing the UN returned to his undersea realm where he was once again crowned Prince of Atlantis. Tamara left Atlantis to live with the Hydro-Men. She was captured alongside them by Attuma, Doctor Dorcas, and Tiger Shark, but was saved once more by Namor. Tamara is later found among the Atlantean terrorist group the Fathom Five. However, she was acting as Namor's inside agent, though she wasn't able to prevent an attack on Beijing or Manhattan. It was revealed when Radioactive Man attacked Tamara due to her being part of the Fathom Five, he planted radiation on her that, while harmless to Tamara, would kill the Atlanteans once she returned to their camp.

With her brother and Tony Stark, Tamara founded Imperio Techworks. Tamara even briefly had a romantic connection with Tony Stark. It was this romantic connection that caused the Pride to kidnap her with plans to sacrifice her to the Gibborim in the "Rite of Blood". Fortunately, she and Tyree were saved by Iron Man, but in exchange for a truce with the Pride, Tony was forced to leave California. He appointed Tamara as the C.E.O. of Imperio Techworks before he left.

tamera aquilonian.name: Tamera (Aquilonian)
tamera aquilonian.origin: Tamera was the daughter of Commander Metrius. After her mother's death, she was brought along by her father to the Venarium fortress in Cimmeria. She became the lover of Gaeric, a young Gunderman of the Aquilonian garrison, who was always hanging around her. Conan came to fancy Tamera during his visits to Venarium. fancied earlier During the Battle of Venarium and its aftermaths, after having slain Metrius, Conan followed Tamera, battling with Gaeric into Dagon's Cave, but finally let them go while protecting them from the People of the Dark. fields.history: Tamera was the daughter of Commander Metrius. After her mother's death, she was brought along by her father to the Venarium fortress in Cimmeria. She became the lover of Gaeric, a young Gunderman of the Aquilonian garrison, who was always hanging around her. Conan came to fancy Tamera during his visits to Venarium. fancied earlier During the Battle of Venarium and its aftermaths, after having slain Metrius, Conan followed Tamera, battling with Gaeric into Dagon's Cave, but finally let them go while protecting them from the People of the Dark. A similar confrontation occurred in the Modern Age, with Jim O'Brien who intended to murder Richard Brent and take Eleanor Rand for himself, but instead sacrificed his life to save them from the People of the Dark (after himself reliving the events following the sack of Venarium through the eyes of Conan).
fields.notes: Tamera was originally created by Robert E. Howard as a Briton woman in his Cthulhu Mythos story "People of the Dark" (Strange Tales; June, 1932), which involved "Conan the reaver", a Gael raider battling Britons. The story was freely adapted in (June, 1975), written by Roy Thomas and penciled by Alex Nino. The adaption set the story in the immediate following of the Battle of Venarium.

tamika bowden.name: Tamika Bowden
tamika bowden.origin: ===Early Life=== Tamika Bowden, a potential Olympic medal winner, was the victim of an unfortunate accident that confined her to a wheelchair for the rest of her life. Her father Dennis Bowden, a mechanical engineer who graduated with top honors from M.I.T., created an exoskeleton for her so that she could walk again. His creation worked so well that Tamika became stronger, faster, and more agile than she ever was. ===Wildstreak=== With her new abilities she wanted to go out in the world and make a difference, so she donned a costume and became the vigilante known as Wildstreak. The main target of her vigilantism was a New York City mob boss named Big John Buscelli. He was the man responsible for Tamika’s accident because of her father’s refusal to work for him, and now he was going to pay. Tamika felt that she had a duty to take him down in order to prevent any other innocent people from being maimed by him, and tracked Big John all the way to Florida. Buscelli already had other problems with a business associate, Emanuel King, scamming from one of his Florida operations, but King had recently acquired an ally in the alien symbiotic entity called Dreadface which he planned to use against Buscelli. Tamika arrived at King’s hotel, a front for the Buscelli money laundering operation, and began searching for evidence against him when she encountered a piece of the symbiote. 180px|thumb|left Wildstreak's initial contact with the symbiotic life form would have been disastrous if not for a timely intervention by one of the hotels other guests, the Thing (Benjamin Grimm). Ben almost immediately recognized the entity from their first meeting and saved Wildstreak’s life by running enough electric current into the portion of the alien to dissolve it into nothingness.In the meantime, Dreadface was planning to take over the world, and would eliminate anyone in his way including Emanuel King who turned on his partner. King only wanted to get out from under Buscelli’s rule and had no knowledge of the alien's true goal, but Dreadface assaulted King and left him for dead. Wildstreak and the Thing found him, but it was too late to save him. Ben left to confront the alien while Wildstreak stayed with the dying man. King convinced Wildstreak to help him over to a statue on the hotel grounds, and once there, he activated the hotel’s self-destruct sequence. Knowing she couldn’t stop the inevitable explosion, Wildstreak raced to warn the Thing, and the two were saved because of the Thing’s teenage nephew from the future, Psi-Lord, as he shielded them from the blast with a psychic force field. The hotel was completely obliterated and Dreadface was seemingly destroyed. Back in New York, Big John Buscelli was dealing in illegal gun running, and Tamika was ready to put a wrench in the works. During a raid on one of his warehouses, Wildstreak found a large stash of guns and a former junior high school classmate by the name of Carl Washington who was working for Buscelli. Washington had been selling guns to kids at the school that Kevin Masterson attended, and it almost led to Kevin being shot accidentally. Kevin’s father Eric, better known as Thunderstrike, began to investigate the situation as did the vigilantes Bloodaxe and Sangre. Wildstreak and Thunderstrike stumbled across one another and were at odds for a brief moment until a gunshot snapped them back to reality and reminded them who the real enemy was. Thunderstrike held off a group of armed thugs while Wildstreak tried to reason with Carl. Carl recognized Tamika and was going to betray her by exposing her secret identity to the people he worked for in order to get in their good graces. As the battery pack that allows her exoskeleton to function ran out of juice, Tamika sat crippled in the street powerless to stop her former classmate as he ran away. Carl Washington never got a chance to say anything to anyone for after he left Wildstreak lying helpless on the sidewalk, he was shot dead by Sangre. ===Civil War=== Refusing to comply with the Superhuman Registration Act, she was arrested by Iron Man, Spider-Man and the NYPD, along with Lectronn, Lightbright, and Phone Ranger. While in the custody of Mister Fantastic, of the Fantastic Four, Wildstreak was freed from her containment unit as she was being transported to the Negative Zone for imprisonment. She escaped both Reed Richards and the armed guards that were attempting to recapture her with the help of the Invisible Woman. ===Red Hulk=== Bowden joined the U.S. Army, eventually changing sides to aid Red Hulk against the War-Wolf.
abilities: Highly trained and athlete.
weaknesses: Exoskeleton needs batteries to work which have a limited lifespan so needs recharging after prolonged usage. When they have no power Wildstreak is practically paralyzed.

tammuz jordan.name: Tammuz (Jordan)
tammuz jordan.origin: ===Origins=== thumb|left|Tammuz before his transformation Tammuz was a young man that lived in a village in what is now modern-day Jordan in the year 9500 BCE. Tammuz befriended Shalim, the son of the village elder Adad, and the two conspired to run away together - feeling Adad had lost his mind and was leading their people to ruination during a prolonged period of drought and famine. When Adad discovered their plot, he captured Tammuz and took him to the edge of a bone-strewn crater where a meteorite they called the Good Green Eye had landed. Adad explained to Tammuz that once their land had been bountiful - a gift from their patron deity, the Mother Goddess - but that they had taken too much without giving anything in return. Angered, the Mother Goddess had cast down her eye, which had blighted the land with its green glow. Adad then revealed the reason why he brought Tammuz to the crater: to use him as a human sacrifice to help their tribe survive. Despite Tammuz's protests, Adad kicked him into the crater where the meteorite ripped his body apart as it sucked him into itself through what he saw as a green gateway. Tammuz later returned to life, transformed into a hulking humanoid monster with horns and green skin. Sensing underground streams with clean water his people could use to weather the drought, Tammuz realized that the Green Eye's power could be harnessed to provide his people with new technologies. Deciding to postpone leaving with Shalim in favor of using his new knowledge and powers to lead not only his people but the surrounding tribes as well into an age of prosperity, Tammuz set out to return to his village. However, he was attacked by his fellow villagers, caught in a net, and stabbed by spears. Tammuz realized that his fellow villages didn't recognize him and tried speaking to them, but his words came out as gibberish. Tammuz was eventually killed by an arrow fired by Shalim, who realized too late that the monster was Tammuz upon spotting recognized a unique birthmark Tammuz possessed. After dying, Tammuz's spirit was transported to a barren wasteland and greeted by a being made of green vapor that called itself the One Below All. As it stated that its sole purpose was destruction, Tammuz - bitter and angry over being betrayed by his fellow villagers - told the One Below All that he wanted to destroy things as well. As the One Below All stated its weapon was hate, Tammuz agreed and the One Below All opened a Green Door for him. Later that evening, Tammuz's fellow villagers consumed his flesh. Adad lied that Tammuz had willingly sacrificed himself to the Good Green Eye, and that they could not only survive but prosper in their barren land if they sacrificed the surrounding tribes to the Eye. Tammuz came back to life and began reconstituting his body, causing his fellow villagers to be ripped apart as the flesh they had consumed burst out of their stomachs and mouths; leaving Shalim the only survivor as he had refused to eat Tammuz's flesh. As Tammuz finished regenerating, Shalim tried to explain to Tammuz that he didn't know he was the monster when the villagers killed him. Tammuz briefly considered letting go of his rage, sparing Shalim, and sharing his new knowledge with the surrounding tribes, but was compelled by the One Below All's hatred to kill Shalim and leave his home village alone. ===Ancient Times=== thumb|right|Enkidu (before retcon) Tammuz, under the name of Enkidu, became friends with Gilgamesh, King of Uruk, after meeting and fighting him. The duo killed many creatures in the adventures they had together, including evil giants and huge bulls. Enkidu sought to die in battle, so when he heared of a "child god" called Eldest after saving a family from a bunch of monsters, he went after her. Arriving in the "fallen city" of Nineveh, Enkidu confronted Eldest, who called him the "Fractured Son". Eldest bested Enkidu and wore his flesh, as she needed his gamma power to free her Mother. However, the One Below All himself appeared, incinerating them both with his gamma-irradiated manifestation, as he was her mother's enemy. Eldest left Enkidu's body to dodge the One Below All's flames, allowing Enkidu to slay her, before succumbing himself. Nineveh was taken back by the mortals, who built a king's tomb to Enkidu, adorned with Eldest's bones, and sacrificed many slaves to serve him in the afterlife. With Enkidu's death, Gilgamesh contemplated mortality, as he was somehow unaware of his own Eternal nature at the time. ===Legacy=== Enkidu's skull was recovered from the Ottoman region by someone who tried to pass it off as a new dinosaur. It was acquired by a paleontologist who offered it to a friend, the scientist Samuel Sterns I, who believed it to be a hoax due to the skull not being fossilized. His body was found years after by a group of archaeologists in the Al-Qādisiyyah Governorate, inside the crypt built in his honor for defeating the Eldest. It was transported to the Temple of

tanas.name: Tanas
tanas.origin: Circa 6000 BC, about 12,000 years after the Great Cataclysm, Tanas was the king of the nomadic tribe of Homo mermani barbarians who wandered and plundered the Western Sea, the western part of what is now the North Atlantic Ocean. His arch-foe was Stegor, king of the similarly-barbaric and nomadic Eastern Sea Tribe. Both tribes sought a homeland and wished to claim the sunken ruins of Atlantis and the long-forgotten treasures of the surface-men. Since neither were willing to let the other claim that prize, the two warring tribes were determined to fight to the death and came to the ruins to do so. Tanas was accompanied by both his wife, Queen Elanna, and their daughter, Princess Zartra. As was customary, the two rulers engaged in single combat before any other fighting began. Riding on dolphins, Tanas and Stegor battled in a joust of kings and Tanas died when Stegor's lance pierced his heart. In response, Queen Elanna personally led the charge against Stegor's hordes and, when she encountered King Stegor, killed him in battle with her own sword. After driving her standard through Stegor's lifeless heart and into the earth, Elanna declared, "In the name of Tanas and love -- Elanna rules the seas!"

fields.occupation: King of the Tribe of the Western Sea
fields.creators: Steve Gerber; Howard Chaykin; Joe Sinnott
fields.history: Circa 6000 BC, about 12,000 years after the Great Cataclysm, Tanas was the king of the nomadic tribe of Homo mermani barbarians who wandered and plundered the Western Sea, the western part of what is now the North Atlantic Ocean. His arch-foe was Stegor, king of the similarly-barbaric and nomadic Eastern Sea Tribe. Both tribes sought a homeland and wished to claim the sunken ruins of Atlantis and the long-forgotten treasures of the surface-men. Since neither were willing to let the other claim that prize, the two warring tribes were determined to fight to the death and came to the ruins to do so. Tanas was accompanied by both his wife, Queen Elanna, and their daughter, Princess Zartra. As was customary, the two rulers engaged in single combat before any other fighting began. Riding on dolphins, Tanas and Stegor battled in a joust of kings and Tanas died when Stegor's lance pierced his heart. In response, Queen Elanna personally led the charge against Stegor's hordes and, when she encountered King Stegor, killed him in battle with her own sword. After driving her standard through Stegor's lifeless heart and into the earth, Elanna declared, "In the name of Tanas and love -- Elanna rules the seas!"
powers: Atlantean Physiology
fields.notes: According to the Tales of Atlantis story in , the war between the two nomadic tribes took place in the sunken ruins of Atlantis 5,000 years after the Great Cataclysm. This would place the war and the founding of undersea Atlantis at c. 13000 B.C. However, other stories and various Official Handbook entries give different dates. On maps of the Hyborian Age the body of water to the west of the main continent of Hyboria is called the "Western Sea" or the "Western Ocean" but this was not the territory that Tanas controlled. Instead, Tanas only controlled the westernmost portion of that ocean while Stegor's realm was the easternmost portion.

tanba yagyu.name: Tanba Yagyu
tanba yagyu.origin: Six years ago, in Japan he was the teacher of Blade and Kikyo Mikage. Two years later, Eric left to go with Van Helsing and Tanba showed them both the third deadly sword technique. Two years later, sick with lung cancer and after finishing Kikyo's training, he convinced him that he had to leave. Half a year before the start of the series, he received a supposed letter from Van Helsing asking for his help in killing a vampire. thumb|left|260px|Sick with lung cancer One night he arrived at the agreed place where after seeing Deacon Frost and a group of vampire ninjas he realized that it was a trap. Tanba killed several ninjas and Frost grabbed him by the neck and forcibly turned him into a vampire. In Vietnam he appeared to Blade and Kikyo whom he revealed to be a vampire and told them how he was transformed. Tanba fought Blade and Blade drove a silver stake into his shoulder. Tanba before he died, he thanked him for restoring his humanity and assured his two students that it was an honor to have taught them.

tandy snow.name: Tandy Snow
tandy snow.origin: Tandy Snow was a reporter for the London Times who attended the press conference of Ka-Zar who had returned to London to find a geologist who could help him investigate a madness seizing the inhabitants of the Savage Land. The press conference was attacked by Klaw and Tandy was injured. When Ka-Zar visited her in the hospital, she introduced him to Kirk Marston, a scientist who offered to inspect the Vibranium in the Savage Land. Tandy organized a plane (paid for by her newspaper) to travel to the Savage Land, expecting the story of her lifetime. Arriving there, they found that the Savage Land had been invaded by the Sheenarians. After they had defeated their initial invasion force, Snow accompanied Ka-Zar when he traveled to their home dimension to prevent further incursions. There, Tandy was discovered by the Quarlians, who believed her to be the object of an ancient prophesy, brainwashed her and made her their queen, Tandylla. When the Quarlians captured Ka-Zar, Tandy demanded that he become her King, which he refused. She then sentenced him to death in the arena, but he managed to escape.
abilities: Tandy was a capable hand to hand fighter. Even though she had only taken a few jiu-jitsu classes, she managed to hold her own in combat against Sheenarian and Quarlian soldiers.

tani uiruson.name: Tani Uiruson
tani uiruson.origin: Deathstroke was ordered to kill David Ishima after David discovered that a building under construction had secret room within it, which a Yakuza gang planned to use as its base. Deathstroke's Terminators captured David as well as his girlfriend Jessica Drew aka Spider-Woman. David and Drew were taken to the building where Deathstroke planned to kill them, but Drew unleashed her bio-electric powers as a distraction, allowing her to escape. She then changed into her Spider-Woman costume and rescue David. David and Drew quickly defeated Deathstroke's minions, forcing Deathstroke to fight Drew himself. While Deathstroke had superior fighting skills, Drew's superhuman abilities allowed her to knock Deathstroke out in one punch. Deathstroke later turned up as one of three applicants applying for an open position on the Red Skull's Skeleton Crew. He competed against Cutthroat and the Mangler. Skull escorted the three applicants to a room and told them that they had to fight to the death in order to get the job. Deathstroke injured both opponents with shuriken, but Cutthroat quickly recovered and killed Deathstroke.
abilities: Skilled combatant
weapons: Shuriken, energy blade

tania.name: Tania
tania.origin: Born a shaman's daughter, Tania was wife to Turghol the Khitan and mother of his children. Lured to possess the Blood of Bel-Hissar, she accidentally set their entire village ablaze while attempting to steal the jewel. She then met Conan in the Turanian camp where the survivors were brought, and helped the Cimmerian escape and free the rest of the prisoners. As she told the truth to Turghol, he attempted to murder himself to expunge the curse. When the Cimmerian returned to the Kozak camp with Gonar and Red Sonja, Tania informed them that her husband sign-tongued that he was suspecting Conan's identity. When Turghol, Fafnir, and Zula were supposed to be dead and about to be burned, Tania managed to pick the mirror containing the three souls and get her husband up out of the fire.

tanir.name: Tanir
tanir.origin: Tanir was a cro-magnon hunter living on the prehistoric earth around 50,000 B.C. one day while hunting he spotted the young Tuk attacked by a pair of Goreks, using his arrow he killed one of the Goreks and after that he used a wine to save the lad from a snake that was lurking him. Tuk was surprised to find another hairless man, as before that day he didn't knew anyone but himself. Tanir was impressed by the eyes of Tuk who showed no fear. Tuk told Tanir his story and how he was the son of a man exiled from the city of Attilan and how he was trying to return to his land and avenge his father; Tanir being a natural born fighter felt envy about the quest of Tuk and he decided to become his companion and using his archery abilities to aid him in his battle. In their travels, the duo would save some humans from the savage Hairy Ones and continue on through the Valley of the Mists. There they would succumb to the mists anesthetic properties and become prisoners of the Witches of Endor. Breaking free, they would slay the witches and rescue Princess Eve, ruler of Atlantis, she would convince Tuk and Tanir to aid her in freeing her kingdom from the rule of her evil uncle for forced her into exile. Tuk and Tanir would accompany Princess Eve into Atlantis where they would fight off the armies unleashed by the evil ruler. Despite the vision of his Soothsayer, the evil ruler would be disposed of by Princess Eve. She would offer Tuk and Tanir a home in Atlantis, however they would decline deciding to carry onward to find Attilan. On their further travels they would save a woman named Eve and her baby from the evil Bonzo and his tribe of savages. While Tuk would bring the woman to safety Tuk would attempt to break up Bonzo's tribe internally by offering them the secret to his bow and arrow. Bonzo would not be so easily convinced of Tanir's loyalty and command him to slay Tuk. However, Tuk would direct a herd of stampeding elephants into his tribe, sending them to flee. Without his minions to protect him, Bonzo would meet his end at the hands of Tuk's bow.
abilities: Tanir was an expert archer.
weapons: Bow and arrow

tanis newhouse.name: Tanis Newhouse
tanis newhouse.origin: Tanis Newhouse was originally the head of Public Relations at the Clinic for Paranormal Research until its founder Philip Nolan Voigt was missing, presumed dead. Craig LaGraves was initially elected interim director, but was given a massive stroke and left in a coma by Dexter Charne, his rival for the position. Charne was killed by one of the 'antibodies' of a patient, Randy O'Brien, and with LaGraves still in a coma, Newhouse was elected to run the Clinic in their place. Newhouse's term as director of the Clinic was a troublesome one, and included staff cutbacks, racial tensions between patients, murders and even a full-scale riot. When a disgruntled ex-staff member led a reporter to the graves of Charne and another member of staff Tracy Speck in the grounds, the Clinic was raided by the police. When the police entered the Clinic, many of the paranormal patients resisted or tried to escape, and a shoot-out took place, leaving most of the police and some patients and staff members dead. Newhouse was distraught at the loss of life, and the Clinic was shut down. It is unknown what happened to Newhouse afterwards, but she presumably faced charges for covering up the deaths of Charne and Speck.

tanisha walker.name: Tanisha Walker
tanisha walker.origin: thumb|left|150pxTanisha Walker was walking home with her son Lonnie, chatting with her neighbor Beverly in the Jamaica neighborhood of Queens, when they saw some unsavory people on their way and decided to cross the street. Just then, a car pulled up and started a shootout between rival drug dealers. Tanisha and her company nearly got caught in the crossfire, but fortunately, someone who appeared to be Spider-Man intervened from above and captured all the dealers, allowing Tanisha and the others to continue safely. Later, when the real Spider-Man learned of a copycat, he went to Tanisha's house, having learned where one of the two mothers Spider-Man had saved lived. Tanisha and Lonnie initially welcomed Spider-Man with enthusiasm, but then, hearing on TV that there was a fight between the Avengers and Spider-Man, she noticed that the guy at her house was wearing a different costume, frightened, she chased him away, threatening to scream if he didn't leave.
